name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: If corporations are trying to keep this hush-hush, they’re doing a lousy job
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Greedflation [ greed-fley-shuhn ] (noun)

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1942%2E4032634%2EXwvBgK)
---
Take a look at one of the newest entries to Dictionary.com: _**Greedflation [ greed-fley-shuhn ]**_ _A rise in prices, rents, or the like, that is not due to market pressure or any other factor organic to the economy, but is caused by corporate executives or boards of directors, property owners, etc., solely to increase profits that are already healthy or excessive._ Let’s talk about “greedflation.” You know it and I know it: giant corporations will seize any opportunity to pad their profits on the backs of working families. So it’s no surprise that they’ve taken advantage of inflation and supply chain disruptions to jack up prices even higher than necessary to cover increased costs. And if they’re trying to keep their strategy hush-hush, they’re doing a lousy job: executives have flat-out admitted — on public earnings calls — that they’ve raised prices faster than inflation for the sake of higher profits. **I’m fighting back by reintroducing my Price Gouging Prevention Act. Here are some big pieces of what my bill would do:**
* Prohibit price gouging at the federal level — anytime and anywhere.
* Target dominant companies that have exploited the pandemic to boost profits — including companies that brag about increasing prices during periods of inflation.
* Require public companies to clearly disclose costs and pricing strategies at certain times.
* Provide additional funding to the FTC for enforcement.

[**Sound good? Add your name to sign on as a grassroots co-sponsor of my Price Gouging Prevention Act of 2024, and let’s work together to get it passed — because working people shouldn’t have to wince every time they look at their grocery store receipt.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-greedflation/?source=EMZ19Q_FIN_E_20240225_V1S1&t=8&akid=1942%2E4032634%2EXwvBgK) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-greedflation/?source=EMZ19Q_FIN_E_20240225_V1S1&t=9&akid=1942%2E4032634%2EXwvBgK)
---
Price gouging certainly isn’t a new trend. But during the COVID-19 pandemic, big corporations took advantage of the crisis to prey on consumers by price gouging, hiding behind inflation and supply chain disruptions to do it — and we’re still paying the price.
Even though corporations’ costs are coming down and profits are rising, prices remain high for hardworking Americans — rising by 3.4 percent over the past year while producers’ input costs have only gone up by 1 percent.
Take diapers: prices for wood pulp, the main input for diapers, declined by 25 percent last year, yet parents are still paying higher and higher prices for diapers. For many commodities and services, the cost of production has actually decreased.
Meanwhile, unchecked consolidation across nearly all sectors of the economy has enabled dominant giants to boost prices with few consequences, disincentivizing new businesses and harming consumers.
I’m going to keep fighting back — and it’s time to pass my bill to give the Biden-Harris administration, as well as state attorneys general, more tools to tackle corporate greed.
[**Add your name if you agree that we need to crack down on corporate price gouging, and let me know you’re ready to help make it happen.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-greedflation/?source=EMZ19Q_FIN_E_20240225_V1S1&t=10&akid=1942%2E4032634%2EXwvBgK)
Thanks for being a part of this,
Elizabeth

If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Multiple polls have already confirmed that this will be a tight race, so your early support could be what helps Lucas tip the scales.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43978?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D)**
If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly:
[Contribute $10](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43979?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=10&t=11&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D) [Contribute $25](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43979?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=25&t=12&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D) [Contribute $30](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43979?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=30&t=13&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D) [Contribute $50](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43979?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=50&t=14&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D) [Contribute $100](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43979?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=100&t=15&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D) [Contribute $250](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43979?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=250&t=16&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D) [Give another amount](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43978?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=17&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D)
---
**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.
**[FIGHT BACK: ELECT LUCAS KUNCE](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43978?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=18&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D)**
Just as we saw in elections across the country — both this year and in the last decade — pundits and presidential politics won’t be deciding the result of every race in 2024. Voters will be.
**That’s why I’m confident that Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley.**
And with so much at stake in this election — reproductive freedom, health care access, and even our democracy — this race must be a priority.
That’s why I’m asking you today, Peter:
**[Will you join me in supporting Lucas Kunce’s campaign against Josh Hawley for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat? This is one of our best and only opportunities to flip a GOP-held Senate seat in 2024, so I hope you’ll consider adding a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford toward Lucas’ campaign today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43978?refcode=em20240225-4908&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=19&akid=4908%2E614464%2EdpU02D)**

Jason Kander

name: LTC (Ret.) Alexander Vindman
subject: Adam and I did our duty to this country
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=5683%2E5257348%2EbJFA0I ]Adam Schiff for Senate

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em.yNAKTE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240225_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=5683%2E5257348%2EbJFA0I ]Alexander Vindman

Hello Derek,
this is Alexander Vindman.

I wanted to reach out to you on behalf of Adam Schiff in the final days of
this primary election to explain why I believe he deserves our immediate
support.

With Donald Trump clearing the path toward the GOP presidential
nomination, we need Adam in the Senate. [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=feb2024_abs_em.sAcFHC&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240225_PM3_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=5683%2E5257348%2EbJFA0I ]If you’re with me, please don’t
hesitate to rush a donation.

Derek, give me
a moment to explain why I know Adam is the person we need in the United
States Senate at this moment:

On July 25, 2019, as a United States Army lieutenant colonel detailed to
the National Security Council, I witnessed a telephone call between
then-President Donald Trump and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.
Trump called it a “perfect call” — but it was far from it.

During that call, President Trump pressured President Zelensky to
investigate then-former Vice President Joe Biden as a quid pro quo to
continue receiving United States military aid in their yearslong fight
defending their territory from Russian aggression.

I saw this for what it was: a blatant abuse of power, and political
blackmail to aid President Trump in the 2020 election. As the White
House’s Russia and Ukraine expert, I was also disturbed by what Russian
dictator Vladimir Putin might attempt if the United States were no longer
Ukraine’s ally and defense partner.

I alerted my superiors and eventually testified before a closed session of
the House Intelligence Committee, on which Rep. Adam Schiff served as
chair.

Adam conducted a thorough and fair investigation. Interviewed witnesses.
Subpoenaed the relevant information and testimony. And as the lead manager
of Trump’s Senate trial, he secured the first bipartisan Senate vote to
convict a U.S. president in the history of our country.

We both did our duty to this country by protecting our democracy. We
defended the values of truth, justice, and decency. And we’ve been
punished by the Republican Party ever since.

Trump has come after me and Adam Schiff. He’s lobbed attacks at Adam for
his dutiful oversight and his fidelity to the Constitution.

Republicans attack Adam on cable news and at MAGA campaign rallies. They
removed him from his post as the top Democrat on the House Intelligence
Committee. And they censured him last summer along party lines, under
threat by Donald Trump.

Through it all, Adam Schiff has held his head up high. He’s refused to
relent in his efforts to hold Donald Trump and his MAGA allies to account.

That’s why I’m supporting Adam Schiff to represent California in the U.S.

body:
playing dominoes with my mom
| | |
---
Friend, every Sunday my mom and I spend the afternoon playing dominoes together. It's our special tradition — and it's one of the most meaningful parts of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79732628/457344326/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk807-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmM3MDJmYTctNDhkNC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=3LGWQC7UHcfUfHwOQ9PD1DJvmTEYhAHIjNw6ZzQGBiA=)
I owe just about everything in my life to my mom. She made the brave decision to move my family from our home in Ecuador to America. It wasn't easy moving to a new country as a 14-year-old, but I can't imagine what it was like for my mom, having to start all over and working double shifts just to pay rent for a one room apartment.
But friend, my mom never wavered once. **Her constant reassurance, work ethic, and firm belief in the American dream inspired me to fight for a better life.**
I studied hard, got a minimum wage job, and earned scholarships to pay for college. After school, I found a career giving back to my community through public service, eventually becoming the first South American immigrant elected to Congress. I've found purpose in my life, become part of a unique community, and raised a beautiful family.
**Because of my mom's sacrifices, my family got our American dream. And now, it's both a privilege and a joy to be my mom's caretaker, ensuring that she can age with dignity and comfort.** There are a lot of big things that come along with that job — managing her doctor's appointments, advocating for her care, and navigating the all-too-complicated Medicare and Social Security systems.
But it's the little parts of caring for my mom — playing our weekly domino games, cooking a big dinner for her, taking her on trips to her favorite places — that matter most to me.
My ability to give my mom a good retirement is one of the things that I am most grateful for. It's not easy by any means, but I know all too well just how lucky my mom and I are. **These days, it's getting harder and harder for Americans to age with dignity and comfort.**
Far-right Republicans have fought for major cuts to Social Security and blocked efforts to expand Medicare, leaving seniors living paycheck to paycheck. Instead they want to cut or privatize these critical public programs — my opponent Rick Scott actually came up with a plan to _end_ them altogether. Even though I've been able to give my mom a good retirement, the shortcomings of these programs still make it incredibly hard to get her the care and support she needs.
**Every American deserves a good, stable retirement. That's why I'm running for Senate — to fight for people like my mom.[Polls show that we've got a real chance to win, but I'm counting on your help to power my grassroots campaign. subject: FIVE ALARM FIRE: Allred within 2 points
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the NRSC
body:
This is a five-alarm fire! | **CRUZ 42%**
**ALLRED 40%**
_I’m in shock._ We can’t let it happen, Fellow American.

Colin Allred is already within two points of our campaign! I’m sounding the alarm because the Democrats are coming to flip Texas BLUE.

body:

Heidi Ganahl introduces the Rocky Mountain Voice, a new conservative news media platform for Coloradans to be the VOICE of your VALUES.

| **February 25, 2024**
# **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST**
### By Heidi Ganahl
---
| Good evening, Welcome to our Sunday News Digest, where we curate the latest headlines to keep you informed and up-to-date. From breaking news to in-depth analysis, we've got you covered. Sit back, relax, and catch up on the week's most significant stories from Colorado and America. We've sifted through the noise to bring you the news that matters. Enjoy! **[Colorado lawmakers vote to give themselves a pay raise beginning in 2025 (Colorado Politics)](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** Colorado House Democrats pushed through a bill to raise the pay of General Assembly lawmakers, disproportionately benefitting those in the Denver metro area, while offering only a modest increase to non-metro legislators. The bill's passage reflects a disconnect between legislative priorities and the economic challenges faced by many Coloradans, particularly those in rural areas, further widening the gap between lawmakers and the communities they represent. [**A new — and much gentler — property tax hike is proposed for Colorado short-term rental properties (The Colorado Sun)**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) House Bill 1299, proposed by Democrat Rep. Shannon Bird, offers a more moderate approach to addressing short-term rental property taxation compared to the more aggressive Senate Bill 33, aiming to target only those with three or more rental properties. Bird's bill proposes imposing the state's commercial property tax rate on short-term rental properties owned by individuals or businesses with at least two additional properties, while maintaining the residential property tax assessment rate for the first and second homes.

The proposed legislation requires property owners to file affidavits annually, potentially burdening up to 50,000 Colorado property owners with additional administrative tasks and legal implications for false declarations. While Bird emphasizes the simplicity of her bill compared to Senate Bill 33, the latter has garnered support from Gov. Jared Polis and advocates for generating additional revenue for schools and local governments, although concerns persist regarding its impact on property values and local autonomy in regulating short-term rentals. [**Liberal media says Denver made a ‘grave misstep’ in cuts to pay for migrant costs (Colorado Peak Politics)**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Denver Post's editorial board criticizes Mayor Johnston for cutting core services in Denver to cover the costs associated with accommodating migrants, attributing the decision to funding challenges arising from Biden's immigration policies. Mayor Johnston's decision to implement cuts affecting essential services like summer flower bed plantings, Parks and Recreation Center hours, and Department of Motor Vehicle hours aims to save $5 million, a fraction of the city's budget shortfall.
The editorial board expresses concern that these cuts may provoke a public backlash against asylum seekers, undermining support for individuals in need and attributing the decision to political posturing. Criticism is directed at Mayor Johnston for opting to make cuts instead of tapping into the city's emergency reserves or contingency funds, especially considering the magnitude of the migrant-related expenses and the availability of emergency funds.
Mayor Johnston's prediction of a $180 million budget shortfall for the next fiscal year is highlighted, with emphasis on the need to prioritize budget reductions in bureaucratic waste rather than implementing cuts that adversely affect constituents due to broader policy failures. [**Mesa County is not illegal immigrant sanctuary, commissioners declare in letter, resolution (Rocky Mountain Voice)**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Mesa County commissioners emphasize that Denver's illegal immigrant crisis cannot be shifted onto other municipalities. They clarify Mesa County as a non-sanctuary county, citing fiscal responsibility and resource constraints. Mesa County faces challenges such as a significant homeless population, high demand for public benefits, and underfunded programs like the Senior Nutrition Program and hospital funding. Commissioners criticize Denver's decision to become a sanctuary city and reject the idea of transferring migrants to Mesa County. Keep an eye out everyday as we release more original Rocky Mountain Voice content, as well as revamping our "Watch" section with new featured shows and partners. Coming soon -- our events and Speaker's Bureau! We are full throttle ahead so stay tuned for more.
Have a great week ahead, Heidi Ganahl

The Rocky Mountain Voice decided to fact check and provide the results. Following is a glance at some scorecard results and how candidates in various races have fared. Not all candidates in Congressional races have a score, because some have not served either in the state legislature or in Congress. Colorado House Democrats pushed through a bill to raise the pay of General Assembly lawmakers, disproportionately benefitting those in the Denver metro area, while offering only a modest increase to non-metro legislators. The bill's passage reflects a disconnect between legislative priorities and the economic challenges faced by many Coloradans, particularly those in rural areas, further widening the gap between lawmakers and the communities they represent. House Bill 1299, proposed by Democrat Rep. Shannon Bird, offers a more moderate approach to addressing short-term rental property taxation compared to the more aggressive Senate Bill 33, aiming to target only those with three or more rental properties. Bird's bill proposes imposing the state's commercial property tax rate on short-term rental properties owned by individuals or businesses with at least two additional properties, while maintaining the residential property tax assessment rate for the first and second homes. The proposed legislation requires property owners to file affidavits annually, potentially burdening up to 50,000 Colorado property owners with additional administrative tasks and legal implications for false declarations. Mesa County faces challenges such as a significant homeless population, high demand for public benefits, and underfunded programs like the Senior Nutrition Program and hospital funding. Commissioners criticize Denver's decision to become a sanctuary city and reject the idea of transferring migrants to Mesa County. Dear ,
If you opened this email because you remember my playing days with the Dodgers and the Padres, thank you.

Having you and all of America's baseball fans cheering for me and Davey Lopes, Bill Russell, Ron Cey and the rest of the guys as we battled Reggie Jackson, Thurman Munson and the Yankees...
...well, as they say, "Those were the days."
But this email isn't about baseball. In fact, it's a email I never thought I'd be writing to you.

Today, I'm asking you to help me defeat the radical Adam Schiff for a seat in the United States Senate.
Today, I'm asking you to help me start a Republican Comeback Rally that folks will be talking about for generations to come.
Because when you think about it, those 'good-ol' days of the 1970s weren't as good as we tend to first remember.
Baseball was just a welcome distraction from the gloom and malaise that had settled on our country thanks to one failed Democrat policy after another.
I'm running for the United States Senate because 2024 America is starting to look a lot like 1970s America.
You remember what it was like:
- Not only were gas prices sky high, Carter's rationing meant we could only buy gas on even or odd days depending on our license plate numbers. Remember?
- Eleven Israeli athletes were slaughtered at the Olympic Village in Munich by terrorists. Remember?
- Fifty-two Americans were held hostage for 444 days by terrorists in Iran. Remember??
Democrat policies had brought America to its knees.
And now, as Yogi Berra used to say, "It's déjà vu all over again."
There's fear of walking down the street because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. The cost of living is exploding and for the first time causing more people to leave California.
Joe Biden, Adam Schiff and the rest of the Democrats don't care one bit that Americans are having a hard time. I'd go even further to say they welcome the misery so they can keep folks down and dependent.
And I wouldn't blame you if you said, "Steve, I'm afraid America's best days are behind us."
But listen, here's something I also want you to remember...
We Republicans pulled our country out of that 1970's Democratic malaise by electing Ronald Reagan.
We put classic conservative values at the heart of everything we did.
And America became a shining city upon a hill once more.
We can do that again.
It starts by stunning the Democrats with a Senate win in California.
But there's no way I can pull it off without you.
That's why I'm asking you to rush in your $35 donation today
I'm sorry for the urgency but the primary is in less than three months and here's where things stand...
In March, I need to be one of the top 2 vote-getters to get to the November general election.
Adam Schiff will probably take the #1 spot. And polls have me hot on his heels for the #2 spot.
Once we're passed the primary, I know with your help, I can beat him in November.
Why?
First... I've lived and worked in California for over 50 years, and I can tell you -- voters here have had it with the Democrats like I've never seen before.
They are hungry for change, and if you and I work together to reach voters in every neighborhood, on every beach, in every corner of California...
I know we can turn this historic opportunity into a Republican win.
Second... you know I'm not a career politician.
But I do have the one thing a Republican needs to get elected in California...
...name recognition.

## Haley Weighs Options After South Carolina Loss
Donald Trump cruised easily to victory in Saturday's South Carolina primary, beating Nikki Haley by about 20 points and winning almost all of the state's delegates. [Voting results are here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFuxCAQAF8D3VmwXhu7oEjj7tKmtDAsx0bYWJhclN9Hlzr9zEjzcV_vjjMfj3e3k22xrM43ftIKNxhvgCvKYCMRUC_JaqOmeZhgQJms0dvsp0AqxNlp7CfCYIwOKtIGOG6SLShABTBqNYw4dLhp4_rBG6VCiCYKVBS4ldp9Fj5aoph_ypNq58sus02tnZfo3wQsAhbK5BuX43pFu5Yocc4vUsByVt5dZboELFf5aunmXS2ZDydgkdWG85tz5ms0AtVjd_wnyvbv8G8AAAD___67V5M). Haley has said she plans to keep running but learned of a new obstacle on Sunday: The Koch network's Americans for Prosperity Action says it [won't spend any more money](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GO6yAQheGnwR3WMAZjFxS3octtt7QIDPFsiLESFCtvv_LW253iSJ_-r8tyCVx4u_0PD3It1yXExm9aUOIoUS-6Sy4TIQ0dOWVhms2ERnerozgNM4RozATJjtoiXOegAs0mapVSxw4BNSCOCsyoTa-vyobBRAuQUrZZaKDErT7778pbWymXT33Ts4_10RW3tra_xPBPoBfoj-Po91q4caznQaDf6HgJ9Kci0AOe2wj09xpXGfIuN77fWa6h0EcCKD2gwu7p0n5wKfwardBwewQuv2L7s_8nAAD___U2WNc) on her campaign. At the same time, leaders at the No Labels third-party effort said Sunday that they'd ["definitely be interested"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL8GdxvhNdi4oLjGXa690sJmCXvBEBmUyH9_ytWvHmk0mj_39e44cX78dgfZFsrq9sZvWhFwBFSr6rwNREhDR7afpJm1Qa26aPUw75PGQL538xAmY2YMcnPjbKTeaOjYokQlEcde6lHpm9r6yQ16n6T0PkxBKEmeWzlvfwvnFimkq7zpvO3l6JKNrb2qGH4JXAQuLVLklL5M4BLLQZk-VeCyu-Pl-JEFLkoZgzhDLpDcRqmC55P2Vk6o7qqQ-flkiC7RBbUctBV_wYc8eAqcuVG6YCPg3Oik2sgDf7Xdaf3rwylxHSeh5ONw_D-kaz8u-xcAAP__aZNu7w) in Haley as the potential head of their ticket in the general election.
## U.S., British Attack 18 Targets in Yemen
U.S. and British forces struck [18 Houthi rebel targets in Yemen](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1vwyAUAH-NvRHB48sMDF2ypWtH6xkeMS22I6CJ0l9fpXPH0y2n-7jMF8wl79d33Mj3dMwYer7TDAwMAzWrMfpEBCRH8sLyyekJtBpXr5WIlmQQaCkCF9OUzBQkaR4iCUVj9sBBcQAjuDZKn9QiLEodLOcxJpsGxSnmftTT55H3vlIqz-NO9RSObSx-7f3WBvk2wHmAM952erSXekHtORQa4PykjXa2Ht99zazSQqUx7B3DF8utIhW24oaNPbCyK_4gm9wikwMkF6MB6xZtolNaSccFR7Bj9fH2yKXkZuyg-HXDXP6K-r9_fgMAAP__RA9l3Q) over the weekend in retaliation for a new surge of attacks by the rebels in the Red Sea. Officials said fighter jets hit Houthi sites in eight locations, targeting missiles, launchers, rockets, drones, and air defense systems. It's the fourth such combined operation since Jan. 12. The Houthis vowed to continue their attacks, raising questions about [the limited tit-for-tat deterrence](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1u7CAQQOGnwR0WHvBfQXGlK3cbpUtpzcJgJsFmZdhd7dtHSZ36NEffx2W9ICc-tjfcydaQV3SVH7SChEGCWU3jbSAC0g3ZblTT3E_QmyZaBDMYnDT2aEh50IPB2SGEAYBmPzdsQYFRAEOn-sH0rbl2I-rejUp5H8YgjCLPNZ_tZ-ajRgrplR90ti7vTbKx1lsR-p-ARcCCV3fQs7Rb_skClvecuLIrApZ7kQnvh4tU5EFPWerJX1RkzPcaWQbeYqWzyBftdEjc2QtYSs3nS-iFvdD_OzX23QSjbk7rb09OicswCqO2HTn9DtU_eb4DAAD__xCtZsA) strategy the U.S. is following to keep the fighting from spreading. _" We don't want to go down a path of greater escalation that drives to a much broader conflict within the region,_" said Gen. CQ Brown, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
## List: Ranking the World's Richest People
A 2024 ranking of the richest people in the world shows Bernard Arnault, chairman of luxury goods company LVMH, as the wealthiest overall with a worth of $212 billion, followed by Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, and Mark Zuckerberg. The chart breaks down the planet's wealthiest by industry, nationality, and gender. [You can see all the rankings here.](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFutDAQhJ8GOpC9rDF_4eJvrru0KdECa9jIhxFsQHn7iKtTzmg0-vR9PvsnSZJ1_qAXB425p1Hl5B4qaCvAHsspRGbgpuRgven-uQ4clksAB51viGLn0PBgsfV-GKz1gJYIuZQABtAAtNa4Fl2Ng_XUuNEbM03RxwINT6J5r7-yrLpwTD_55L0e86tMYVHdjqL5X8CjgMd1XfUpxzelkTZRSnLoPSzgoQtXu4wLH1ptnLfElazV3V55T9MdbpL3TzPnPCfuT5lXVuVyD9N2SUpytL5AM79I0htA_9TxGwAA__-es2H7) The wealthiest person in sports is Stan Kroenke, owner of the Arsenal football club, and in media, it's David Thomson, chairman of Thomson Reuters. Friend, I have breaking news to share with you... We at America First Legal have just filed an **absolutely momentous** lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona’s election administration laws. The election interference and systematic election law violations we allege in Arizona are appalling, bone-chilling, and have the most serious consequences for every American. We all know what’s going on. _That’s why we are taking action to expose and punish those responsible!_[_**_DONATE NOW TO SUPPORT OUR EFFORTS_ >>** _](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zg87671laenpd5smoqs2naoef9d0vgo3diafrv10_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjhm1or6clh2bs)**We strongly allege numerous serious violations and criminal activity, including:****#1 -** _Maricopa County refuses to maintain the mandatory chain of custody for ballots.**In 2022, these failures resulted in a discrepancy of over 25,000 votes – larger than the margin of victory in the state governor’s race**_**#2 -** _**Maricopa County ignores mandatory reconciliation procedures to track each ballot printed or issued to a voter.** The law requires tracking and reconciling ballots cast and voters checked in to stop fraud, but the Defendants do not perform any reconciliation procedures at all_**#3 -** _Arizona law requires ballot drop boxes to be staffed by at least two election officials positioned close enough to view each person who deposits ballots into it.**Maintaining an unstaffed drop box is a felony. However, Maricopa County maintains unstaffed, unsupervised ballot drop boxes, facilitating illegal ballot harvesting**_ For many years now, the Maricopa County Board of Supervisors and the County Recorder have consistently failed to lawfully administer elections. We believe these individuals are fully aware of their election law violations.**Make no mistake:** Our lawsuit has been filed to prevent the November 5, 2024, election from being tainted with the same mistakes and maladministration that occurred during the 2020 and 2022 elections and to prevent election interference from occurring._Thank you for your support of our mission and historic legal actions here!_[_**_PLEASE RUSH SUPPORT HERE >>_**_](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z1ie6co52b2edd66b929nmrgj7vm89d0t6kgl800_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjhm1or6clh2bs)_** **_ Stephen Miller _President, America First Legal _

| | Hey there, I'm reaching out with an urgent reminder: **_caucus is tomorrow, February 27_** , **_at 7:00 PM_** and your participation is crucial! Please make sure to attend and make your voice heard. You can find your caucus location [**_here_**](http://links.thelukenscompany.mkt6815.com/els/v2/zm49CEVGAkcW/VTU5VDcwTmRlYnBCZ0FoWHBlTkVVdVhpY3krbk5jUDF1bzAyWTVWc21SZG1CR3JkbTFqaFdwSGp3ZEgvM2JQRzNxZlpxNDdIakVCQmtaTnN0KzNuTmFVVlI2U1ptdk5TeTg4NmZJaVRzd1VZSEpSUUozanpBZz09S0/). As we're all aware, this election year carries significant weight. From President Trump down the ballot, Republicans must stand united and motivated to counter the Radical Left's agenda. This holds true nationwide, and especially in Minnesota, where the Democratic agenda threatens everything we hold dear. That's why I'm personally asking you to prioritize attending your local caucus. Should you be given the opportunity to read a letter during your caucus, I've prepared a message for you below that I hope you'll consider sharing. Thank you for your unwavering support and dedication to promoting our conservative values. Thank you, Brad Finstad P.S. Please see the letter below to be shared at your caucus location! **_Caucus Letter from Brad:_** Hello everyone, I am Brad Finstad, and it has been an honor of a lifetime to sit in your seat in Congress for the past year and a half. With your help we were able to fight off a strong Democrat offensive and defend the First District in the August 2022 special election. We were able to carry that momentum into the November general election and win a modern, record result for Republicans in the First District. We also flipped enough seats across the country to take the U.S. House majority, fire Nancy Pelosi as Speaker, and put a stop to one party Democrat rule in Washington. However, that was not the end of our fight; it was only the beginning. We have a golden opportunity to have a Republican trifecta in Washington if we can win in November. While Joe Biden continues to display the failures of his administration both at home and abroad, our party is rallying around Donald Trump to return to the White House. It is no surprise that with Biden presiding over persistent inflation, chaos on our borders, and a collapse of American leadership on the world stage, we have seen his support plummet. Poll after poll shows we are well positioned to take back the White House, with even Minnesota in striking distance. Democrat control of the U.S. Senate is hanging by a thread. Without Joe Manchin running in West Virginia, the Democrats have basically conceded the race. That means Republicans only need to flip one more senate seat to take the majority, and they have at least 3 prime targets. In the U.S. House, we sit in a historically tight majority, currently only a swing of 4 seats. We must maintain every seat we have and hopefully pick up a few more. That is why our work here in southern Minnesota is critical. We don’t want to see successes in the Senate and White House undermined because the Democrats take back the U.S. House. The outcomes of this election could not be more stark. If the Democrats control Congress, we can expect increased spending that fuels even higher inflation, the southern border to remain wide open for illegals, and further decline of America’s voice in the world. If the Republicans could take control, we could see a return to an energy independent America, secure borders and a renewed respect for the rule of law, and a country that returns to the Reagan doctrine of “Peace Through Strength.” I am ready to work shoulder to shoulder with you to win this November and secure the bright future we all want to leave for the next generation. Thank you for your involvement in being here tonight. I am out visiting with as many caucus attendees as I can and hope to see you at an upcoming convention. Thank you for all of your support and all you do for the future of our country. Sincerely, Brad Finstad

**_I wanted to share something with you, Peter._**
First, let me introduce myself — I’m Kelly, Conor O’Callaghan’s finance director. I help Conor keep his finances, fundraisers, and reporting in order, but I also love to get outside and canvas for Conor as much as possible. I love getting to talk to my neighbors about all of the ways Conor is going to deliver progress for AZ-01 in Congress.
Now let me tell you about a conversation I had. This week, I was canvassing and a Scottsdale public school teacher answered her door. **When I told her who I was canvassing for she said she already knew all about Conor — from talking to another educator!** She told me how thrilled so many educators she knows are about having a pro-public advocate and former graduate of Scottsdale public schools fighting for our kids in Congress.

| Peter -
It is easy to get discouraged about politics these days.
We continue to see a wave of retirements in Congress as many are choosing to leave the institution at a time of turmoil and divisiveness. Congress, like so much of our politics, has become toxic. There is a perverse incentive structure in the institution that rewards entertainment and outrage rather than leadership and lawmaking.
But to me, that is all the more reason to stay in the fight.
America is in desperate need of serious, conservative leadership. I have worked hard to deliver that leadership every day in Congress since I was elected almost six years ago.
I serve on the powerful Energy and Commerce Committee, where I am standing up for American energy independence.
I serve on the Intelligence Committee, where I am addressing some of the most pressing national security challenges facing America.
And I serve as Chairman of the Cartel Task Force, where I am developing solutions to destroy the Mexican drug cartels that have operational control of our southern border and are killing Americans with fentanyl poison.
Most importantly, I serve the great people of Texas's Second Congressional District. I want to continue that service, because my district, my state, and my country are worth fighting for.
But I cannot continue serving without your support. Your donations - no matter how small - fuel not only my re-election campaign, but also my efforts to grow the conservative movement by supporting conservatives across the country, hosting engaging events to attract young people into our movement, and winning the message battle against the left.
I know I can count on your support, and I am forever grateful that I have patriots like you standing in my corner as I seek re-election to continue delivering conservative leadership in Congress at a time when America desperately needs it.

Social Security, a vital safety net for millions of Americans, is in danger.
Without swift action, this crucial program could be compromised, threatening the financial security of retirees and vulnerable populations.

body:
It’s no secret that Congress is broken, and has been for years. A big part of the reason for that is lack of accountability. | | | | | I know political emails can be annoying, but it’s the best way for me to share my vision for the future and keep you up to date on the campaign: if you wish to unsubscribe, click [here](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=266d823a9c&t=b&e=26f66c7cbd&c=53ed8654f8).
---
[](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=398ce1de2e&e=26f66c7cbd)
Friend,
It’s no secret that Congress is broken, and has been for years. A big part of the reason for that is lack of accountability.
With more than 90 percent of House incumbents being re-elected year after year, the vast majority of Congressional incumbents know there is little chance they will ever pay a price for their failure to respond to citizens’ concerns.
That’s why I support term limits. Serving in Congress is supposed to be a public service, not a cushy job for life or a retirement plan.
[](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=789c767f52&e=26f66c7cbd)
Term limits for Members of Congress are supported by wide majorities of citizens across all demographic groups.
Caps on time served would dramatically counter-balance all the current advantages held by incumbents, and more competition in congressional districts is simply good for democracy. Being new to Congress, you’d think Hillary Scholten would want to make Congress more responsive to the needs of her constituents. Regrettably she has not endorsed term limits. We have the opportunity to make a change in MI03’s representative stance on this issue in November.
| [DONATE](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=d9ebfd97ad&e=26f66c7cbd)
---
“There’s room for debate about the ideal length of time for term limits, but I support a reasonable cap that properly balances the need for institutional memory and competence while ensuring we are not represented by careerist dinosaurs who are no longer responsive to the people or a lobbyist-state that benefits from a representative body without experience. I remain optimistic that in the new 119th Congress, with new members like me, term limits will receive the support citizens demand and deserve. To get there, I need your support!
If you’re able, [please consider donating $5, $10, or $25 to my campaign so that we can spread the message](https://paulhudsonforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=600300ac5dcd9b542144e2b89&id=e827074129&e=26f66c7cbd) of change to voters in West Michigan.
Here to serve,**Paul Hudson**

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c30894%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qE40QzXda4R4j5KbBHBlHw&sysid=1)

A few years ago, members of the world’s elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, “We need a ‘Great Reset’ of capitalism.” If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that’s not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

**Sign up now using the secure link below, and we’ll send the Great Reset seminar lectures --absolutely free--directly to your inbox.**

Don’t miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

Use the link above to receive your Great Reset video series today.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

Dear Friend,
Today, I am writing to share some good news. The City of Harrisburg recently scored a victory for women's reproductive rights, when the buffer zone that Harrisburg City Council established around the city's Planned Parenthood clinic to protect patients and staff from harassment, obstruction, and potential violence was upheld after an eight year legal battle.
As a member of City Council in my third term, I am proud to be a part of this victory for women's rights. We deserve elected leaders who we know will walk the walk, because when those who represent us stand up and fight, we can win!
Can you pitch-in $25, $50, $100, $250 or more to support my campaign so I can continue to fight for our values in Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
Harrisburg is one of only two cities in Pennsylvania to have a buffer zone, and defending our buffer zone in court has been a long process. Harrisburg City Council established the buffer zone in 2012, and we have spent years defending the ordinance. There have been at least three challenges to it. We could have easily quit fighting and given in, but we didn't. We stood up for what we believe in, and we stood up for the many women who depend on Harrisburg's Planned Parenthood clinic for health and reproductive care.
If you believe we need elected leader who will stand-up and fight, even when it's hard, then I need you to support our campaign with a contribution today. Click here to donate now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
We need leaders who will stand-up and fight, because when we elect those leaders we can win! Last Tuesday eight years of challenges to our buffer zone law came to an end when SCOTUS declined to hear the case (Reilly, Colleen, et al. v. Harrisburg, PA et al). That means the lower court's opinion upholding the constitutionality of our buffer zone stands.
These days, it can be hard to decide which candidates to support. By donating to my campaign today, you are supporting a candidate that you know will fight for us and stand-up for our priorities because that is what I've spent my career doing. Our end of month fundraising deadline is in a few days, and you contribution to our campaign would make a huge difference.
Click here to support a candidate whom you know will fight for the things that matter most! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sdemail2023]
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

body:
The presidential primary in Michigan is just one day away! | | | | |
---

Dear Friend,
As we approach an important milestone in our democratic process, we want to remind you of the significance of tomorrow’s presidential primary in Michigan. **This primary presents an invaluable opportunity for you to exercise your right to vote and have a say in shaping the future of our country.**
At the heart of our democracy lies the fundamental principle of civic engagement. **Voting is not only a right but also a responsibility** that each one of us carries to ensure that our voices are heard and our values represented. By participating in the primary, you play a crucial role in determining the direction of our nation and our state.
Michigan, with its rich history of political activism and civic participation, has always been a battleground state, a place where **every vote truly counts.** In this primary, we have the chance to make our voices heard and to show the rest of the country that we are committed to upholding the democratic values that define us.
**As Democrats, we believe in inclusivity, equality, and progress. We believe in policies that uplift working families, protect our environment, and expand access to healthcare and education for all. We believe in a government that works for the people, not just the wealthy and well-connected.**
So, as we prepare to cast our votes in the Michigan Presidential Primary, let us remember the importance of our role as citizens and the power that each of us holds to shape the future of our country. **Let us stand united in our commitment to democracy, equality, and progress.**
Thank you for your continued support and participation in this critical democratic process. We have a long but exciting road ahead of us to November and we are grateful for your support every step of the way.
Warm regards,Team Alfonso

clean_body: The presidential primary in Michigan is just one day away! | | | | | Dear Friend, As we approach an important milestone in our democratic process, we want to remind you of the significance of tomorrow’s presidential primary in Michigan. This primary presents an invaluable opportunity for you to exercise your right to vote and have a say in shaping the future of our country. At the heart of our democracy lies the fundamental principle of civic engagement. Voting is not only a right but also a responsibility that each one of us carries to ensure that our voices are heard and our values represented. By participating in the primary, you play a crucial role in determining the direction of our nation and our state. Michigan, with its rich history of political activism and civic participation, has always been a battleground state, a place where every vote truly counts. In this primary, we have the chance to make our voices heard and to show the rest of the country that we are committed to upholding the democratic values that define us. As Democrats, we believe in inclusivity, equality, and progress. We believe in policies that uplift working families, protect our environment, and expand access to healthcare and education for all. We believe in a government that works for the people, not just the wealthy and well-connected. So, as we prepare to cast our votes in the Michigan Presidential Primary, let us remember the importance of our role as citizens and the power that each of us holds to shape the future of our country. Let us stand united in our commitment to democracy, equality, and progress. Thank you for your continued support and participation in this critical democratic process. We have a long but exciting road ahead of us to November and we are grateful for your support every step of the way. Warm regards,Team Alfonso | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Alfonso for Congress P.O Box 1375 Holland, MI 49422 * USA or |

subject: The NRA’s tax returns aren’t pretty

body:
Mark my words, friend : Gen Z will outlive the NRA.
The Daily Beast recently analyzed the NRA’s tax returns. They aren’t pretty.
In fact, the pro-gun group’s revenue has been on the decline for years now, especially since Parkland. Last year, their fundraising was at its lowest point since 2008. And since 2018 they have lost over 1 million members.
I firmly believe that the NRA’s days are numbered—and as their power and influence fade into the dustbin of history, we will replace their corrupt, purchased politicians with a new generation of bold, courageous leaders who aren’t afraid to take urgent, necessary action to stop the scourge of gun violence in America.
I co-founded Leaders We Deserve because Gen Z’s answer to the NRA is electing more and more young people to public office to counter their agenda.
With so much riding on the upcoming elections, we’re preparing now so we can elect the leaders we deserve in November. Will you split a contribution to support Leaders We Deserve and Serve America today? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
We founded Leaders We Deserve last year to elect the next generation of leadership—and folks across the country are already helping us shatter expectations.
Not only have tens of thousands of people just like you joined our movement and helped spread the word about our mission, we’ve already elected our very first candidate.
In the days leading up to the November election, we hit the streets in Virginia to knock on doors and get out the vote for Nadarius Clark. Thanks to our supporters’ donations, we were proud to invest more than $100,000 to support Nadarius’s campaign.
When all the ballots were counted, Nadarius won by less than 2,000 votes.
Leaders We Deserve is already playing an integral role in electing the next generation of leaders and we’re counting on your continued support so we can keep winning these fights in 2024. There is too much on the line for us to lose.
Leaders We Deserve and Serve America can only be successful in November with your continued support, so can you split a contribution or whatever makes sense for you today? Anything you can give will make a difference. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-lwd]
Thank you for your consideration,
David Hogg
Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

name: Emily Randall
subject: Add your name to tell Congress to act IMMEDIATELY to protect LGBTQ+ youth
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | | You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta84de9c5-2693-4ee4-9fe5-4b5a3e948611/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| |
---
| | | | | **GOP legislators are moving 400+ anti-LGBTQ+ bills in 2024 — many of them aimed at kids.** [**SIGN to tell Congress: Take IMMEDIATE federal action to protect LGBTQ+ youth →**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7c47bc6e-8702-46c7-a58e-113aa1b244f8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) [****](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tba9bcefd-a75b-441c-ba1a-81e8dc0cf190/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _**“You’re a queer Latina who works at Planned Parenthood. Don’t you think you’re too much for your district?”**_ That’s the “advice” from a political operative as I first considered running for office. I was furious — not just for myself, but for the 400,000 LGBTQ+ people in my state. Were we all “too much”? That interaction lit a fire under me. Not only did I run, I flipped one of the most competitive districts in the Washington State Senate — and I immediately got to work on bills to make life better for working people. I protected my State Senate seat in 2022 when everyone was saying I couldn’t win and even became Deputy Majority Leader. Even now, I’m hearing the same “advice” that boils down to folks being scared of leaders like me who break the mold. Now, LGBTQ+ people, especially queer and trans kids, are under attack from cynical Republican politicians in dozens of states and in Congress. They’ve filed over 400 harmful bills ranging from taking books with LGBTQ+ characters out of school libraries to banning life-saving gender-affirming care. [**That’s why we’re fighting back, state by state — but we need national action. Tell Congress to ACT NOW federal level to stop the attacks on LGBTQ+ youth →**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T95031ea4-894f-41a9-9f0c-5f44c62c2395/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) There are a range of solutions available to Congress. But we need more members with the courage to take action. Here in Washington, we updated the rules for legal name changes, strengthening safety and privacy protections for trans and nonbinary people, refugees, and survivors of domestic violence. We required all contracts for public services to contain anti-discrimination clauses. We passed a shield law to protect those seeking abortion or gender-affirming care in Washington from prosecution or persecution in their home states. And we ensured that trans youth who are not supported at home have access to safe accommodations. I have helped lead these policies, so I know what it takes to get it done. **Here’s the truth: Representation isn’t just symbolic. Having queer and trans people in office saves lives.** Not only do we need to elect more LGBTQ+ people at every level of the ballot, we need a Congress that will treat the attack on LGBTQ+ freedom and equality with the seriousness it deserves. [**This will take ALL of us — so if you agree that we need action, please join my campaign and tell Congress to protect LGBTQ+ students from cruel, cynical Republican attacks →**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta365ab22-c96a-4444-b9fb-da3baf3c340c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you so much, — Emily Randall
Democrat for Congress, Washington’s 6th District _Emily Randall has been endorsed by Planned Parenthood Action Fund, Equality PAC, LPAC, LGBTQ+ Victory Fund, PODER PAC, and dozens of other leaders and organizations. Learn more at[electemilyrandall.com](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te676ff2e-414b-41af-a6cf-0d31dc4fe7ca/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_.

| | | About BlueAmp Action: We cannot sugarcoat the current situation. Right-wing authoritarianism, defeated by a worldwide coalition during WWII, was only in hibernation. Over the past decade it has infected democratic societies--including ours. It is as simple as it is terrifying: What we do now will define the future of our country and world. We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. So our kids grow up in democracy, not dystopia. Thank you for your support for all we do! Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we are able to communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America. But that's not all. We also delve into pro-freedom alternatives to this tyrannical plan.

**Sign up now using the secure link below, and we 'll send the Great Reset seminar lectures--absolutely free--directly to your inbox.**

Don't miss this opportunity to learn lessons that are essential to the defense of American liberty.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Donald Trump is the single greatest threat to our democracy. Our best
chance to defeat him is to support Joe Biden in this election. Amy and I
voted for him in the Texas primary on Tuesday and are looking forward to
voting for him again in November.

This president has done an extraordinary job of improving our economy,
confronting the climate crisis, reducing childhood poverty, and fending
off the very worst of Donald Trump and the Republican Party’s mounting
attacks on our most fundamental freedoms.

Of course, there are areas where many of us would like to see this country

body:
Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?

| |
---
| | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z97q3uh8oehms9fonv9nslk9s40gjmpcpptu04f0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjge8oj6cph2bs)
---
| | Friend, **[**Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zpb8lir3cp183uqoh8b0fpoo0c6t5bj8rf7fnduo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjge8oj6cph2bs)** That’s the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November.I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to “choose” between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee......and that’s being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go “three up...three down” against this lineup of liberal career politicians.That’s a bit of baseball vernacular.No surprise, right?It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning.Then, it’s your team’s turn to go on offense. Well, that’s very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country.Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years – most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I’m reaching out to you today.**[Will you step up and help strike out this “lineup of liberals” through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zb5juqbb8ujtoe3tsmu708v92ouioe78l8jsttm8_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjge8oj6cph2bs)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California.Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California.• Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a “false choice” between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z81cl88lp1s1rgikr1g05hu7am05o5bv7csll19o_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjge8oj6cph2bs)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:
---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign “connecting the dots” between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.
---
In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That’s my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. **[But I need your help. I’d consider it a great honor to have you on my campaign team. I also consider your support a must have in order to win this race.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z7eu2ci6q3tudi23gqj9ue67k0ue3jpuvfhmih58_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjge8oj6cph2bs)** With you on our side, I’m confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again.
---
| | With deepest appreciation,
---
---
Steve GarveyRepublican for United States Senate
---
|
---

---
| | |
---
|

**MY VISION**
---
My campaign is focused on quality-of-life issues, public safety, and education. As your U.S. Senator, I will serve with commonsense, compassion, and will work to build consensus to benefit all of the people of California.I’ve been fortunate to wear many hats in life – from professional athlete to businessman to philanthropist. But the one thing that has remained consistent is my love for this great state and my desire to make a difference.In baseball, it’s not about the individual; it’s about the team. I believe the same holds true for politics. It’s time we come together, find common ground, and work towards a brighter future.

I was recently visiting with my 95-year old father (his name is Ed, and he lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me about a photo that — well I just _had_ to share it with you.
Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.
We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.
This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.)
While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day.
**In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God.**
These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office.
And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours.
That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day.

clean_body: = Peter, I was recently visiting with my 95-year old father (his name is Ed, and he lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me about a photo that — well I just had to share it with you. Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah: = I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith. Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause. = If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: = = = = = = I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company. We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school. This photo was taken when my family was a member of Temple Isaiah in Lafayette, California, a reform synagogue we joined after moving to the Bay Area. And it came after months of practicing for my Bar Mitzvah. I even taped my practice sessions on our tape recorder (I have a copy of that tape somewhere, believe it or not, voice cracking and all.) While the Hebrew language skills I quickly acquired were just as quickly lost, the lessons that my faith taught me endure and guide me to this day. In fact, my favorite passage comes from Micah: What is required of us, but to do justice, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy God. These principles have guided my work in Congress. They have led me to pursue criminal justice reform, to make housing the homeless a key priority, to attack discrimination, and to ensure the rule of law is applied equally. They have also guided my path as I held accountable and stood up to the most unscrupulous man to ever occupy the Oval Office. And they guide me in the fight we face today: repairing and rebuilding our democracy so that we leave it better for my children and yours. That’s why I put everything I have into my work in Congress and for the cause of our democracy. It’s the first thing I think about when I wake up in the morning, and I don’t rest until I’ve done all I can for the day. = If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: = = = = = = Hopefully, this photo helped brighten your day and gave you a bit more insight into why I have dedicated my life to this cause. Shalom. subject: Russia and the United States
body:
Winston Churchill once described Russia as “a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma”

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1s24tcaq4hho95du5gihp0g92hv2ulvgvu55ff0_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjgeco34c5h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's current war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history.

In the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

**The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a [FREE online video series on Russia](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zlom89jeehtpebnd0d0jj0ol8kokh9goumjooubo_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjgeco34c5h2bs). **

In our online video series, based on a recent conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--including the "Greats" such as Peter and Catherine--with special attention to the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union.

The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy--and to classical music, through such composers such as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

**You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's enigmatic relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. **

You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/russia-cca/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvi2bqn17fvs9hblvdtf8r8l0qvgds6ss8bhsd98_rp22sh2s8i6eo30sjgeco34c5h2bs)

**Please use the secure link above to immediately receive your video series on Russia.**

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

A lot of campaigns use shady tactics to get you to donate. Big matches with huge multipliers, fake deadlines, all that stuff. Not us.
#

Peter,
You probably get a lot of emails that put you on edge.
A lot of campaigns use shady tactics to get you to donate. Big matches with huge multipliers, fake deadlines, all that stuff. Not us.
We’ll never put up one of those fake matches — your donation is your donation. It’s why you’re so important to this campaign. And we’ll make you a promise today: **Every deadline we set will be tied to a real goal.**
Whether that’s our mid-month deadline — an important milestone that lets us know if we’re on track to our goal.
Our end-of-month deadline — tied directly to our monthly goal, what we have to raise each month to win this race.
Or our end-of-quarter deadline — the official FEC deadline that marks the close of the quarter, when we’re legally required to file a public report disclosing what we’ve raised.
We’ve got one of those end-of-month deadlines coming up this Thursday, and it’s important that we hit our goal. That’s why we’re reaching out — and why we’ll reach out a few more times between now and then.
Because whether we defeat Kari Lake and Kyrsten Sinema, whether we raise what we need to win this race and defend our Senate majority, all of that — it comes down to you. But you’re not alone, and by the time you’ve read this far a few of Ruben’s supporters have already chipped in.
They’re hoping you’ll join them. That’s the only way we’ll win this campaign: Together.

body:
>From the Tippecanoe Co. Lincoln Day Dinner to the Congress of Counties, it's been another great week on the campaign trail! Let's hit the highlights!

https://www.crouchforindiana.com/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Friends and fellow Hoosiers,

>From speaking at the Tippecanoe County Lincoln Day Dinner to attending the Congress of Counties in downtown Indianapolis, it's been another fantastic week on the campaign trail, connecting with Hoosiers and sharing my bold vision for Indiana!

Let's hit the highlights!

** IN THE NEWS: Crouch shares goals, vision in Republican gubernatorial primary campaign (https://www.idsnews.com/article/2024/02/suzanne-crouch-indiana-governor-race-2024-election-republican-primary?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

I️ had a great conversation with the Indiana Daily Student highlighting my bold vision for Indiana, my experience and how I'll use that experience to deliver results for Indiana.

As Governor, I️ will protect Indiana from foreign adversaries like China, invest in mental health and Axe The Tax, putting more money into your pocket and creating a more competitive economic environment in our state.
https://www.idsnews.com/article/2024/02/suzanne-crouch-indiana-governor-race-2024-election-republican-primary?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ARTICLE (https://www.idsnews.com/article/2024/02/suzanne-crouch-indiana-governor-race-2024-election-republican-primary?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN THE NEWS: Indiana parents warn nation after child is removed from home for improper pronoun usage (https://www.foxnews.com/media/indiana-parents-warn-nation-after-child-removed-home-improper-pronoun-usage-can-happen-anywhere?fbclid=IwAR1Y65Lrb-TisXrfKTEny9MdrhskZhABqG7XICm_DsqweboB6YaeX-HtO6U&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------

DCS’s intrusion into the Cox’s private family matter is a blatant and unwarranted overstep. It's a stark violation of privacy and parental autonomy, setting a disturbing precedent on the limits of government interference in our personal lives.

As your next governor, I'll ensure parents are in the driver’s seat on all matters and put an end to overreach by state agencies, creating a more streamlined, smaller government that respects the rights of Hoosiers.
https://www.foxnews.com/media/indiana-parents-warn-nation-after-child-removed-home-improper-pronoun-usage-can-happen-anywhere?fbclid=IwAR1Y65Lrb-TisXrfKTEny9MdrhskZhABqG7XICm_DsqweboB6YaeX-HtO6U&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
ARTICLE (https://www.foxnews.com/media/indiana-parents-warn-nation-after-child-removed-home-improper-pronoun-usage-can-happen-anywhere?fbclid=IwAR1Y65Lrb-TisXrfKTEny9MdrhskZhABqG7XICm_DsqweboB6YaeX-HtO6U&utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

** IN Focus Indiana interview with Dan Spehler
------------------------------------------------------------

https://www.facebook.com/reel/1055010348901326?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

I️ had a candid conversation with Dan Spehler of IN Focus Indiana Politics on Friday, where we tackled the critical issues confronting our Hoosier state.

>From protecting Indiana from foreign threats like China to prioritizing mental health initiatives and eliminating Indiana's individual income tax, my bold vision for Indiana is one of resilience, prosperity, and opportunity.
ARTICLE (https://fox59.com/news/politics/in-focus-crouch-opponents-prepare-for-debates/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=f58d078f7f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_02_22_08_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f58d078f7f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

_That’s why we saw voters overwhelmingly pass a constitutional amendment to enshrine abortion rights in the state constitution in red Ohio._
_It’s why voters in even deeper red Kentucky re-elected Democratic Governor Andy Beshear._
_It’s why even here in Iowa — a state with a new oppressive abortion ban — a Des Moines Register poll showed that**more than 3 in 5 Iowans support reproductive freedom.**_
