body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d4bf863bb4a3487a98f357be2dedb9df&_e=W2s7Yu7degZF2Tm64v11vKjn8-sIHRHmDWYxju6YuH4VMpTn8zXORerr5DvJfLVO4Xj2zpj7zGPLwXUfNYyj0MwGqkxS3a86cxViHDw4Jr9KFNVdklKibMnWAeXFidoQleL3V05gT0KGnI3cE9VaNIb8HJmDaACFvGVG-7zRQeXsaXFKD5F-MnRxkPIKxHhgwQcW8JWvAp8lO6q40WdGQrg5jgTkXwW2I7vnogBOtb7LX-K8vlyYnBbgmmbRTXL-_hd6ex8jgA4CwRZCFryYP2dS_Lr_uXoQVSj73HWpTN2t-JaQR5PKqpq3Cfi6i66I81aG5oLscZ-v3_pB6gTHxqE-Ly4uLUdHa6D2NC7UL6s_LgHOyCbwdRXKVjdHx7IjeGkkjVFb0MnrsbQxrz55LoITGf1GYW7DqicYaFMbRcI%3D) Dear Fellow American,

Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. | | Friend, **[**Will you help me strikeout the liberal lineup of Adam Schiff, Katie Porter, and Barbara Lee on March 5th?**](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkM2OmzAUhZ_G7Bz5DztZsMiUJJtJVVE0XVr-uYAlTJBtJurbV7Tpfraf7j063_l113cT5rCM302EpqSiU9bW69GkT_iNs5vCMGhGmMCEYSY1rXwjFPNcVtBQRY4nReiJVFMjHLVU2FpST7yQSvGBW2WUlOBcfSRVaPYcwpikitGaHE7EMSqoNYNxqqYDEsTMkEo-lAkSrJudgzNLARMP7hGruZlKWTPiZ8SuiF0zuC3B4RmWBH6_2FmBT8Cv-sMj4S3jDIspgNjVg6VHxqF2ZuDW1IhftxJ1fmzJAeLtW3vD3eUDMbnjCD5sEfH2cn8RZ-Jqwrgg3v5TIVS_tTf98_btrN_fdXf50D_OuO_610NxiLd91-P_5lVq_PoM8xyyVEiQMZow_5UrX1r_TwAAAP__CCiH3g)** That’s the day of the California primary. The top two go head-to-head in November.I can think of only one thing worse than a General Election ballot that forces Californians to “choose” between three dyed-in-the-wool leftists like Schiff, Porter, or Lee......and that’s being forced to endure six years of Schiff, Porter, or Lee in the U.S. Senate. I need your help to go “three up...three down” against this lineup of liberal career politicians.That’s a bit of baseball vernacular.No surprise, right?It means you record three outs against the first three batters in an inning.Then, it’s your team’s turn to go on offense. Well, that’s very much the case in this election... ...you and I need to strike out this lineup of liberals so we can get to work saving our country.Liberals straight out of Congress where all three have spent a combined 51 years – most recently acting as rubberstamps for the Biden agenda that has done so much harm to our state and our nation. Which is why I’m reaching out to you today.**[Will you step up and help strike out this “lineup of liberals” through a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today?](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkM2OmzAUhZ_G7Bz5DztZsMiUJJtJVVE0XVr-uYAlTJBtJurbV7Tpfraf7j063_l113cT5rCM302EpqSiU9bW69GkT_iNs5vCMGhGmMCEYSY1rXwjFPNcVtBQRY4nReiJVFMjHLVU2FpST7yQSvGBW2WUlOBcfSRVaPYcwpikitGaHE7EMSqoNYNxqqYDEsTMkEo-lAkSrJudgzNLARMP7hGruZlKWTPiZ8SuiF0zuC3B4RmWBH6_2FmBT8Cv-sMj4S3jDIspgNjVg6VHxqF2ZuDW1IhftxJ1fmzJAeLtW3vD3eUDMbnjCD5sEfH2cn8RZ-Jqwrgg3v5TIVS_tTf98_btrN_fdXf50D_OuO_610NxiLd91-P_5lVq_PoM8xyyVEiQMZow_5UrX1r_TwAAAP__CCiH3g)** Think about the crumbling quality of life in my once-great state of California.Think about the daily reality of:
---
• Fear of walking down the street, taking their kids to school, or running a small business because of rampant crime, homelessness, and drug addiction. • The exploding cost of living (gas, food, shelter) which for the first time in our history is causing more people to leave California.• Failing public schools and plummeting test scores. The numbers don’t lie... prolonged school closings not only robbed our kids of learning but of social interaction.
---
If you believe, as I do, that voters deserve better than a “false choice” between Schiff, Porter, and Lee on November 5, 2024, **[**then I need you to take immediate action and rush a contribution of $15, $25, $50, or more today.**](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkM2OmzAUhZ_G7Bz5DztZsMiUJJtJVVE0XVr-uYAlTJBtJurbV7Tpfraf7j063_l113cT5rCM302EpqSiU9bW69GkT_iNs5vCMGhGmMCEYSY1rXwjFPNcVtBQRY4nReiJVFMjHLVU2FpST7yQSvGBW2WUlOBcfSRVaPYcwpikitGaHE7EMSqoNYNxqqYDEsTMkEo-lAkSrJudgzNLARMP7hGruZlKWTPiZ8SuiF0zuC3B4RmWBH6_2FmBT8Cv-sMj4S3jDIspgNjVg6VHxqF2ZuDW1IhftxJ1fmzJAeLtW3vD3eUDMbnjCD5sEfH2cn8RZ-Jqwrgg3v5TIVS_tTf98_btrN_fdXf50D_OuO_610NxiLd91-P_5lVq_PoM8xyyVEiQMZow_5UrX1r_TwAAAP__CCiH3g)** Winning this election requires a one-two punch:
---
1\. Finish in the top two on March 5th (very doable as the Democrat vote will be split three ways). 2\. An eight-month grassroots and TV, radio, and online campaign “connecting the dots” between the policies pushed by Schiff/Porter/Lee and the brutal reality facing Californians every day.
---
In my playing days, I would never be out-worked or out-hustled. That’s my approach to this campaign. Door-knocks, phone-calls, rallies, townhalls, you name it. **[But I need your help. I’d consider it a great honor to have you on my campaign team. I also consider your support a must have in order to win this race.](http://email.alerts.therepublicanteam.com/c/eJyMkM2OmzAUhZ_G7Bz5DztZsMiUJJtJVVE0XVr-uYAlTJBtJurbV7Tpfraf7j063_l113cT5rCM302EpqSiU9bW69GkT_iNs5vCMGhGmMCEYSY1rXwjFPNcVtBQRY4nReiJVFMjHLVU2FpST7yQSvGBW2WUlOBcfSRVaPYcwpikitGaHE7EMSqoNYNxqqYDEsTMkEo-lAkSrJudgzNLARMP7hGruZlKWTPiZ8SuiF0zuC3B4RmWBH6_2FmBT8Cv-sMj4S3jDIspgNjVg6VHxqF2ZuDW1IhftxJ1fmzJAeLtW3vD3eUDMbnjCD5sEfH2cn8RZ-Jqwrgg3v5TIVS_tTf98_btrN_fdXf50D_OuO_610NxiLd91-P_5lVq_PoM8xyyVEiQMZow_5UrX1r_TwAAAP__CCiH3g)** With you on our side, I’m confident we can not only give voters a real choice, but someone who remembers how great California was and knows how great it can be again.

Winston Churchill once described Russia as “a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma”

This sponsored message from Conservatives Give is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=92bcce30e0c64de7afa334c628d45103&_e=xS2JaxvcKGQHRRal6cfVrRDWCrq3MNOt5RQm6QjjYKnjhgLbjYBwsF_DWBTybk5hE_WEX83O2pYRCa9xVy_gaLDly-RedpbFtJp7mTkgDxkNNsEkNVzX1Kln_DawHvMTc7bg3DjA_9vmoD9sJJ-zXvWrsBEHvoxhOnzgkQTgFZGe8eSXp-2CKiax26K1sm3ufSxmcQpi56uJGXuIwO0ruvxXHclh8_Q6WZCufrWllUsglCSQa9oQcB98dtwZctYYP5RhNhcGWnMst1CcQ4cm0Fg1ktWgMIh1A596Jqyi1NTcvIs0j3NBpFxc8z37qw9lTKRgM4VGLn1BwNBLymFmx62fbeKQ2MLQg3CoboFqvBg%3D)

| | Dear Fellow American,

Winston Churchill once described Russia as "a riddle, wrapped in a mystery, inside an enigma"--words that still ring true.

But given Russia's current war with Ukraine--and Russia's role in the shifting balance of power in today's world--a better understanding of Russia is critical.

Since Peter the Great, Russia's place among nations has only grown. As it transformed itself from a regional backwater to a great power, its politics and culture influenced significant events in our own history.

In the Cold War period between World War Two and the fall of the Soviet Union in 1991, American-Russian relations became the focus of world attention.

**The need for a better understanding of post-Cold War Russia, in light of its current importance and its long history as one of the world 's great powers, is why Hillsdale College has created a [FREE online video series on Russia](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=92bcce30e0c64de7afa334c628d45103&_e=xS2JaxvcKGQHRRal6cfVrRDWCrq3MNOt5RQm6QjjYKnjhgLbjYBwsF_DWBTybk5hE_WEX83O2pYRCa9xVy_gaLDly-RedpbFtJp7mTkgDxkNNsEkNVzX1Kln_DawHvMTc7bg3DjA_9vmoD9sJJ-zXvWrsBEHvoxhOnzgkQTgFZGe8eSXp-2CKiax26K1sm3ufSxmcQpi56uJGXuIwO0ruhGaGpQl7XNunGRnZhO1MHtTyX75iacbRABtwhKdpYrdlrHvTUDXVAOFu4-suS48e3rPOuj3x6nXRh_iGCmoB1J2VJpteysrEeLT2olQ3cvZzu3wn9Q41RO5d7AdXpyQeD3a6c66jvwcYaGvqIC2C3o%3D). **

In our online video series, based on a recent conference held at Hillsdale College, you'll learn more about Russian history--including the "Greats" such as Peter and Catherine--with special attention to the Russian Revolution through the fall of the Soviet Union.

The video series also explores Russia's significant contributions to literature, through such authors as Dostoyevsky and Tolstoy--and to classical music, through such composers such as Tchaikovsky and Rachmaninoff.

**You 'll also gain a deeper understanding of Russia's enigmatic relationship with the West today, and about the causes and complications of the current Ukraine war. **

You can receive instant access to this free video series right now using this secure link:

[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/russia-cca/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=92bcce30e0c64de7afa334c628d45103&_e=xS2JaxvcKGQHRRal6cfVrRDWCrq3MNOt5RQm6QjjYKnjhgLbjYBwsF_DWBTybk5hE_WEX83O2pYRCa9xVy_gaLDly-RedpbFtJp7mTkgDxkNNsEkNVzX1Kln_DawHvMTc7bg3DjA_9vmoD9sJJ-zXvWrsBEHvoxhOnzgkQTgFZGe8eSXp-2CKiax26K1sm3ufSxmcQpi56uJGXuIwO0ruuLl6suHiuKCuyef_Igef8osEZ12L8I7oLbj3q6pajulJvq33U5CzGbpt6LtY4pNiv6lr6ayMyEUruWGjBfrx5EMOugGNozFa5TeWGaRX_31o-aHxnYpKtq0WXuMyHEDOueXGLgHX5LD57fIXaFXsIc%3D)

-> \*\*_"I hope Nancy gets the help she needs. I really do... She’s got a lot of challenges." -FORMER Speaker of the House, Kevin McCarthy_\*\* <-

This aint my first rodeo, Fellow American.

I’m used to people underestimating me. _Truly!_

I didn’t become the first woman to graduate from The Citadel's Corps of Cadets by having a lot of people believe in me.

I didn’t pick myself up after dropping out of high school and go waitress at Waffle House to put food on the table because of handouts.

I didn’t become a strong conservative FIGHTER in Washington DC because I didn’t face challenges.

\*\*_NOPE!_\*\*

I got to where I am because I am a fighter. I’m not afraid to get dirt under my fingernails and sweat on my brow for the things that I believe in. _ \*\*And I believe in America.\*\* _ I will fight until the day I die for what is RIGHT in this country – _and I’m not a sell-out to corporate greed like the former Speaker._

Which is why he is coming after me on his revenge tour. I can’t be bought. My vote is not for sale. I work for the American people and the American people ONLY. _Which frankly scares the HECK out of people here in Washington who aren’t used to people they cannot control._

\*\*So, today, I’m taking the former Speaker’s advice:\*\* \*\*I’m asking for help. _Not from lobbyists or party leaders but from the people I work for._ Help from you\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=1825332.874.1.eaa3afdc2ec35aa44adad13f56d16a15 )

Everyone in Washington is after me. They are throwing MILLIONS of dollars against me, but I don’t care because I know I can rely on you to help me claw my way back to Washington and keep fighting the good fight. \*\*Any amount you can spare today, even if it’s just sharing my story, would mean the world to me.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=1825332.875.1.d4f60c694bf8505ca9c6e6f698e87a4d )

-> \*\* SEND ME BACK TO WASHINGTON » \*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=1825332.876.1.2aab38a9f2853c064d6b60e83b47ed98 )<-

I’m not going to give up, Fellow American. If they’re coming after me, it means I’m doing something right. _It means I’ve disrupted the swamp._ \*\*All I can count on is you.\*\*

\*\*Please help me today before it’s too late.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=1825332.877.1.7962920e7a4b4d57011cf5c902ce08a5 )

Friend,
Rep. Bergman publicly claimed that the federal government should have no role in abortion decisions. But, his votes tell a much different story.
Here are the facts, Jack.
Bergman sponsored H.R. 431, the ‘Life at Conception Act’, which would provide “equal protection under the 14th article of amendment to the Constitution for the right to life of each born and preborn human person.” This would federally restrict IVF and ban abortion. Nationwide. In every state.
He also sponsored H.R. 705, the ‘Heartbeat Protection Act,’ a federal abortion ban that would punish medical providers for up to five years if they perform an abortion after six weeks. Nationwide. In every state.
Bergman and the GOP only support ‘states rights’ when they agree with the oppressive laws they want to enforce nationally.
If the GOP gains power, make no mistake, they will quickly move to make state draconian laws national.
Women in MI01 deserve better. Women in Michigan deserve better. Women across the country deserve better.
But, there's good news:
Before this cycle, Rep. Jack Bergman has never faced a second-time challenger, and against Dr. Bob Lorinser, he's in for the most intense fight of his political life. The last repeat Democratic candidate in MI01 came within half a percentage point of defeating another GOP incumbent.
With your help, Dr. Bob can absolutely can do this. Bergman can be defeated. He has the best candidacy and the best opportunity to send Bergman home, wherever that is.
Join us.
-Women for Dr. Bob

subject: We need pro-choice leaders like Lizzie

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240223?refcode=lpfe240223 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240223?refcode=lpfe240223]
You might remember me as the Texas state senator who in 2013 filibustered for 13 hours in pink sneakers against a measure that would restrict access to abortion care in our state.
Unfortunately, abortion restrictions have become even worse and more extreme in the past 10 years. After the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , over 20 states banned or restricted abortion with Texas having one of the most severe bans in the country.
I know from experience how important it is to have pro-choice leaders fighting for us at every level of government—including leaders like Lizzie in Congress. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240223?refcode=lpfe240223]
There is a way every Texan, and every American, can fight back against the attacks on reproductive freedom: speak out against those taking away our freedom and support those who are fighting to restore it.
That’s why I’m proud to endorse Lizzie for re-election. She’s led efforts to codify Roe into law in all 50 states, protect the right to travel for reproductive care, and protect access to birth control and abortion medication—all of which have faced threats since Roe was overturned.
Defending and restoring abortion rights everywhere—especially at this critical time—is a fight that requires all of us to get involved. We need to work twice as hard and twice as smart to continue advancing equality for women in this increasingly hostile environment.
I'm up for the challenge. As a member of #TeamLizzie, I know you are, too.
Voting has begun for Texas’ March 5 primary, and Lizzie has a primary challenge this year. Please contribute any amount you can to Lizzie’s campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240223?refcode=lpfe240223]
In solidarity,
Wendy
Wendy Davis
Planned Parenthood Texas Votes Senior Advisor
Former Texas State Senator

That's why we produced "[**C.S. | | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyUkTGP3CAQhX8N7mzBwLF24eIkn6u7S5QUKRFmZtdIgC3AOd2_j7zaRFG6lDBv3jfz5sebebM--HR7t5HGa8gmF5OsWX0IbaAPX1q3Zl-qt8kAB9VyaEEb0eDIxYBKNTSKC--Hi1KgmnUcCKUVqLnkYlgELuJqVd8vXF7dglo0fjx9OIAWvdBPfQe4OIeL7LVeBs4tU9wGyrW7ZiLcok0Y_EK5fmbat1w7t8UmjGute2HymcHMYC7kjkzYnYMXtIE6woPB_Od9ao797G9d-Xc1Xz9b_IlMzsUxOXEOIN85KHgVT9OX6eXlOwN91GjKdmRHTE573spOrvp0e5QioT8ikxNF68Pj09m4W39LTE6umDvV_E01J_Uh3VKlVJmcvj638-u39ndMTR5x__Ah-KIvTPHb6X8Pof7PxX4FAAD__8LFous).

clean_body: His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Dear Friend, C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read. His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith--making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century. That's why we produced "" which you can now own on DVD. | | | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including: good and evil, conversion and faith, prayer and the Bible, suffering and death, * heaven and hell, and much more. Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis and After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man, and the co-editor of The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns! This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity. That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with . Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College | | Freedom Liberty Report PO Box 1188 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

body:
I grew up in Squirrel Hill, a small neighborhood of Pittsburgh. I learned early on what it meant to be a fighter, to stand up for others when they couldn't stand up for themselves.

Team,

I grew up in Squirrel Hill, a small neighborhood of Pittsburgh. I learned early on what it meant to be a fighter, to stand up for others when they couldn't stand up for themselves.

When I was a high school freshman, my brother Anthony was diagnosed with muscular dystrophy. Insurance companies called it a pre-existing condition, and refused him coverage. The bills piled up, even after he died at the age of 20.

After returning from Vietnam, my dad turned to drugs and ended up in jail, leaving my mother and me to keep our family business going. I took any job I could get to make ends meet and put myself through college.

But my story isn’t unique. We’ve all had our struggles. From losing my brother, to seeing my dad behind bars due to addiction, I’ve seen how our current political and justice systems fail so many people. body:
I hope you’ll join me
| | |
---
Friend —
Let’s talk about Florida. I know some people like to write us off, but I know that this year we can prove them wrong. We’re a diverse state full of people who believe that we all have a right to a better future. **I am proud to support Debbie for the U.S. Senate because I know she’s the leader who can make that vision of a better future a reality for millions of Floridians —[ and I hope you’ll join me. ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79779365/457456049/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk842-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjBmOTZlYmMtZDVkNC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BykocEuQ9mIs21OayWOrjLRbfSWFjCLkz2qqtPlMwlg=)**
In my district, and everywhere I go around the state I hear Floridians talk about the issues they’re facing, and the inaction from our leaders in the GOP. We’re on the front lines of the climate crisis, but Rick Scott has dismissed it as “nuisance flooding.” We’re one of the last safe havens for abortion in the South, but Rick Scott has supported a nationwide ban on abortions. We’re the state with the largest enrollment in the Affordable Care Act, but Rick Scott is still pushing to repeal it. We’ve witnessed mass shooting after mass shooting in our state, but in the Senate, Rick Scott has voted with the NRA 100% of the time.
These are all debates that should have been settled years ago — but GOP extremists like Rick Scott are trying to keep them alive in Florida. We can’t let them.
Debbie is a candidate who understands the challenges Floridians face every day. Like so many Floridians, she is an immigrant who is proof that the American Dream is a reality. She’s a mom who understands the importance of quality education and safe schools. She’s a daughter who is her aging mother’s caretaker, and has seen how critical programs like Medicare and Social Security are. She understands the gun violence crisis because she lost her father to gun violence, and has dedicated her career to creating a safer world. **Debbie represents Floridians. Rick Scott represents himself.**
This election has the potential to change our state for the better, but Debbie is up against Rick Scott and his massive fortune. That’s why I’m asking you today: **[ Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can to help Debbie build a grassroots movement that can defeat Rick Scott? ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79779366/457456050/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk842-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjBmOTZlYmMtZDVkNC1lZTExLTg1ZjktMDAyMjQ4MjIzNzk0IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=BykocEuQ9mIs21OayWOrjLRbfSWFjCLkz2qqtPlMwlg=)**

clean_body: I hope you’ll join me | | | Friend — Let’s talk about Florida. I know some people like to write us off, but I know that this year we can prove them wrong. We’re a diverse state full of people who believe that we all have a right to a better future. I am proud to support Debbie for the U.S. Senate because I know she’s the leader who can make that vision of a better future a reality for millions of Floridians —= In my district, and everywhere I go around the state I hear Floridians talk about the issues they’re facing, and the inaction from our leaders in the GOP. We’re on the front lines of the climate crisis, but Rick Scott has dismissed it as “nuisance flooding.” We’re one of the last safe havens for abortion in the South, but Rick Scott has supported a nationwide ban on abortions. We’re the state with the largest enrollment in the Affordable Care Act, but Rick Scott is still pushing to repeal it. We’ve witnessed mass shooting after mass shooting in our state, but in the Senate, Rick Scott has voted with the NRA 100% of the time. These are all debates that should have been settled years ago — but GOP extremists like Rick Scott are trying to keep them alive in Florida. We can’t let them. Debbie is a candidate who understands the challenges Floridians face every day. Like so many Floridians, she is an immigrant who is proof that the American Dream is a reality. She’s a mom who understands the importance of quality education and safe schools. She’s a daughter who is her aging mother’s caretaker, and has seen how critical programs like Medicare and Social Security are. She understands the gun violence crisis because she lost her father to gun violence, and has dedicated her career to creating a safer world. Debbie represents Floridians. Creates a Class 1 misdemeanor for any person who imports, sells, manufactures, purchases, or transfers an assault firearm, as that term is defined in the bill, and prohibits a person who has been convicted of such violation from purchasing, possessing, or transporting a firearm for a period of three years from the date of conviction. The bill provides that an assault firearm does not include any firearm that is an antique firearm, has been rendered permanently inoperable, is manually operated by bolt, pump, lever, or slide action, or was manufactured before July 1, 2024. The bill also prohibits the sale of a large capacity ammunition feeding device, as that term is defined in the bill. The bill provides that any person who willfully and intentionally (i) sells an assault firearm to another person or (ii) purchases an assault firearm from another person is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor and that any person who imports, sells, barters, or transfers a large capacity ammunition feeding device is guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor. The bill also makes it a Class 1 misdemeanor for any person younger than 21 years of age to import, sell, manufacture, purchase, possess, transport, or transfer an assault firearm regardless of the date of manufacture of such assault firearm.

Amends charitable gaming law to allow, as a condition of receiving a charitable gaming permit or authorization to conduct electronic gaming, certain organizations to use a predetermined percentage of its receipts for expenses related to the rental of real property where such real property is involved in the operation of the organization and used for lawful religious, charitable, community, or educational purposes. The bill (i) prohibits the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services from promulgating electronic gaming regulations that prohibit (a) devices that display spinning, rotating, or rolling reels or animations or flashing lights; (b) devices that accept vouchers; or (c) the purchase and play of an electronic pull tab with a single press or touch of a button. The bill also requires qualified organizations and electronic gaming manufacturers to pay one-quarter of one percent of its gross receipts or adjusted gross receipts, as appropriate, to be deposited by the Department into the Problem Gambling Treatment and Support Fund.

Establishes the Charitable Sports Raffles Act for the purpose of authorizing athletic event drawings, defined in the bill, to be conducted by affiliated nonprofit organizations that conduct such drawings in accordance with regulations promulgated by the Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services. The bill places limits on when and where an athletic event drawing may be held and requires the prize amount of any such drawing to be 50 percent of the total amount collected from the sale of the tickets. The bill requires the organization to donate a certain percentage of the remaining funds in accordance with Department regulations and imposes certain civil and criminal penalties for violations of the provisions of the bill. Candidate for MN House Seat 1B
Hello! I hope you are enjoying this nice weather before we get one more blast of cold this week! __________________________
**
REMINDER: Caucuses are Happening on the 27th ** __________________________ If you plan on going, please let me know what precinct you are in, and if you are hoping to be a delegate! Becoming a delegate is a great way to influence your party. For those who were wondering about the Political Contribution refund, it takes about 2-3 weeks to get your money back once you send it in! I just got mine back. **DID YOU KNOW... In Minnesota, you can be refunded up to $75 a person or $150 per couple** for donating to your favorite state candidate or political party. You can do this once per year. It takes about 2-3 weeks to get your refund. If you would consider donating to our campaign I would appreciate it. Consider it a loan that the state will repay for me! In all seriousness folks, it is time for us to change the business as usual attitude going on at the state capital and within the GOP. **If you want to shake things up, and send the message enough is enough, I am your man. ** Most of you know I am not your typical politician, I say what I mean, and mean what I say. I stand up for what I think is right and believe with all of my heart in the Constitution of this great nation. **I will not stand by and watch your rights be trampled.** Mayor Gander allowed the resources of the city of East Grand Forks to be used to push and enforce the state mandates of the lock downs while right across the river it was business as usual. He spoke in support of Governor’s Waltz’s lock downs while I was out fighting them. Mayor Gander has stood by as taxes have been raised on the people of East Grand Forks and even now, he is supporting a one percent raise in city sales taxes (lasting 20 years!) Do you think people will accept that? Or, will they bring their business across the river to Grand Forks causing East Grand to suffer? A friend of mine once told me what he called the Golden Rule of how to vote – he said, believe half of what a politician tells you and everything he actually shows you. I have been there on the streets protesting the lock downs and vaccine mandates. I have been at the capital leading rallies to keep our troops home unless Congress actually declares war (and will be doing it again at the Defend the Guard Rally on March 23rd in the Rotunda of the Capital). Mayor Gandor has been supporting the Governor and raising taxes, is that what we want of our representitive in the state legislature? __________________________ **I**once again ask for your support.****
* Become a delegate to support my endorsement of the Republican Party in District 1B.

* Support the campaign with a financial donation.

__________________________ Thank you! And remember... raise cattle not taxes (you silly mayor!) In liberty,
Bull

clean_body: | | | | | | | | February 26, 2024 Candidate for MN House Seat 1B Hello! I hope you are enjoying this nice weather before we get one more blast of cold this week! ________________________ REMINDER: Caucuses are Happening on the 27th ______________________ If you plan on going, please let me know what precinct you are in, and if you are hoping to be a delegate! Becoming a delegate is a great way to influence your party. For those who were wondering about the Political Contribution refund, it takes about 2-3 weeks to get your money back once you send it in! I just got mine back. DID YOU KNOW... In Minnesota, you can be refunded up to $75 a person or $150 per couple for donating to your favorite state candidate or political party. You can do this once per year. It takes about 2-3 weeks to get your refund. If you would consider donating to our campaign I would appreciate it. Consider it a loan that the state will repay for me! In all seriousness folks, it is time for us to change the business as usual attitude going on at the state capital and within the GOP. If you want to shake things up, and send the message enough is enough, I am your man. Most of you know I am not your typical politician, I say what I mean, and mean what I say. I stand up for what I think is right and believe with all of my heart in the Constitution of this great nation. I will not stand by and watch your rights be trampled. Mayor Gander allowed the resources of the city of East Grand Forks to be used to push and enforce the state mandates of the lock downs while right across the river it was business as usual. He spoke in support of Governor’s Waltz’s lock downs while I was out fighting them. Mayor Gander has stood by as taxes have been raised on the people of East Grand Forks and even now, he is supporting a one percent raise in city sales taxes (lasting 20 years!) Do you think people will accept that? Or, will they bring their business across the river to Grand Forks causing East Grand to suffer? A friend of mine once told me what he called the Golden Rule of how to vote – he said, believe half of what a politician tells you and everything he actually shows you. I have been there on the streets protesting the lock downs and vaccine mandates. I have been at the capital leading rallies to keep our troops home unless Congress actually declares war (and will be doing it again at the Defend the Guard Rally on March 23rd in the Rotunda of the Capital). Mayor Gandor has been supporting the Governor and raising taxes, is that what we want of our representitive in the state legislature? ______________________ Ionce again ask for your support.** Become a delegate to support my endorsement of the Republican Party in District 1B. * Support the campaign with a financial donation. ______________________ Thank you! And remember... raise cattle not taxes (you silly mayor!) subject: Spartz Responds to Goodrich’s Pathetic, False Attack Ads
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Victoria Spartz for Congress
body:
Today, Victoria Spartz for Congress released the following statement in response to Chuck Goodrich’s pathetic, dishonest campaign ads:

“Chuck Goodrich does not have a record of fighting for conservative values. Goodrich runs for office to benefit his own business and personal bottom line with Hoosiers’ tax dollars. Now he’s running a smear campaign distorting Victoria Spartz’s record and counting on the local media not to hold him accountable.

Goodrich’s recent ad accuses Spartz of not being tough on border security or crime. The reality is that Spartz has traveled to the border numerous times, fought for aggressive oversight of the Biden administration’s failed immigration policies, encouraged Indiana sheriffs and the Governor to help the state of Texas, pushed for tough border legislation, fought with the leadership to include border security in the must-pass appropriations, supported bills to support law enforcement and toughen punishment for crimes commiteed by illegal aliens, fought for legislation cracking down on Chinese fentanyl, and advocated for designating Mexican cartels as a Foreign Terrorist Organization. Goodrich’s attacks are desperate and false.

Chuck Goodrich is just another big government Republican who would give the Department of Justice, the FBI, and activist federal prosecutors more power to persecute conservatives just as they have done to President Trump and his allies while allowing liberal rioters and violent criminals to commit crimes with impunity.”

Background:

Goodrich references two bills in his false tv ads: the “Smarter Pretrial Dentation Act” and “Right to Trial Act”.

The Smarter Pretrial Detention Act followed in the footsteps of the First Step Act, led by President Trump, and was endorsed by the American Conservative Union (known as CPAC). All this bill does is allow judges discretion on pretrial detention for nonviolent crimes to consider each individual case more fairly and free up overwhelmed system to better deal with violent offenders. The conservative FreedomWorks group also voiced their support for this legislation introduced by Senator Mike Lee on the senate side, with their President Adam Brandon urging members to call their senators and encourage them to support the bill. The Right to Trial Act is truly an attempt to strengthen the 6th Amendment constitutional right to trial and mitigate abuses of prosecutorial authority in our federal justice system, as we have seen most recently with the January 6th defendants.

These are some rare occasions when real constitutional conservatives, who believe in the equality of rights and a fair justice system for all Americans, not just for the rich and politicly connected, and liberals can find common ground. Similarly, what is happening now with the FISA Sec. 702 re-authorization legislation protecting 4th Amendment rights against warrantless surveillance of the U.S. citizens, fought by Reps. Jim Jordan and Jerry Nadler on the same side against the D.C. establishment.

They don't like debating with me with regard to important legislation in the House, and **they cannot stand how we're helping the American public come to the realization that Democrats are more focused on partisanship than getting things done for the American people**.

So, if you agree with me that:
1. **We need to secure the southern border**

Yesterday, 25 year-old Aaron Bushnell lit himself on fire outside the Israeli embassy in Washington, DC. As an active duty U.S. service member, his sacrifice is particularly jarring and should draw the world's attention to the need to finally, as he exhorted with his dying breaths, "[Free Palestine](https://substack.com/redirect/e4381de5-f8c3-4b2d-a4f4-64878cf97af9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!"
This was a young man who swore his life to defend the security of the United States, only to see it degraded by the decisions of civilian commanders unapologetically committed to a genocide targeting a civilian population.
[Aaron's statements] are not the words of someone suffering from illness, but rather those of a lucid being responding to the illness of an ignorant and belligerent civilization that refuses to heed either the demands of international rights or the sacrifices of the veterans who secured them.
Aaron's profound act of sacrifice demands observation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/df96b23b-2ea6-4c31-9bf2-b496a58f34ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **A lucid act of self-sacrifice in defense of human rights**
Some might argue that Aaron was mentally ill. Others will describe his act of protest as suicide. They all would do well to grapple with the lucidity of his thoughts, and his words as he gave away his life to defend others.
Aaron's self-immolation was neither an act of despair, nor one driven by confusion. It was an act of moral desperation undertaken by a person whose thoughtful concerns deserve to be heard.
Aaron explained his sense of moral urgency. Before lighting himself on fire, he [said](https://substack.com/redirect/e95ad256-29d2-4cd8-b326-6520af493d74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> "My name is Aaron Bushnell, I am an active-duty member of the United States Air Force and I will no longer be complicit in genocide. I am about to engage in an extreme act of protest, but compared to what people have been experiencing in Palestine at the hands of their colonizers, it's not extreme at all. This is what our ruling class has decided will be normal."
These are not the words of someone suffering from illness, but rather those of a lucid being responding to the illness of an ignorant and belligerent civilization that refuses to heed either the demands of international rights or the sacrifices of the veterans who secured them.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=142075731&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQyMDc1NzMxLCJpYXQiOjE3MDg5Nzc0OTQsImV4cCI6MTcxMTU2OTQ5NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.mSiPy-Onr7cyz1BB9Th_to0vxVWPnw3PJuVbj4_2qC4)
### **Reality more compelling than any fiction**
Several ironies about Bushnell's act of sacrifice deserve to be noted.
First, many outlets have discussed Aaron's sacrifice while suppressing the video featuring his own words in his own voice. Many have claimed to have censored the video because it is disturbing.
It is indeed disturbing--but no more so than the images of Palestinians digging the bodies of their children out of the rubble of what were their apartment buildings.
Aaron intended for his sacrifice to be seen. That's why he recorded it. Despite efforts to hide the video of his self-immolation from the public, it [remains available and is worth watching](https://substack.com/redirect/6b38e77b-02ea-41b5-87c6-3f4c1ad1187a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Next is the bizarre absurdity documented by the video, which captures a militarized police officer drawing a weapon on Aaron as he lit himself on fire, before another officer explained that "I don't need guns, I need fire extinguishers!" This moment not only encapsulates the characteristic response of the American "justice" system to any particular problem.
What drove Aaron to self-sacrifice was the belligerence of U.S. foreign policy and its disregard for human suffering. That same callousness is also reflected in domestic policing, and the institutional tendency in both contexts towards escalating violence at the slightest--or even [imagined](https://substack.com/redirect/2b93b8ad-51df-49b1-adce-5587c358cf92?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--provocation.
Finally, another irony emerges when considering the limited rights of U.S. service members, particularly given their legal obligation to follow the orders of civilian commanders. When pledging their lives to defend national security, U.S. service members give up rights enjoyed by civilians under the First Amendment. They are still allowed to vote, but the [farcical nature](https://substack.com/redirect/a3cfcb08-81d6-463f-a747-af829ee8cedf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the 2024 presidential election reduces that choice to [meaninglessness](https://substack.com/redirect/acf55451-d91e-4a2e-8c16-843662690a15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Interestingly, international law requires members of militaries to [refuse](https://substack.com/redirect/6780a92b-7cd5-4cef-a9d0-68e80c61c8e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to follow orders that are illegal, regardless of where they are in their chains of command, and who issues the orders. There is no legal justification for following illegal orders, such as those violating human rights, nor can the defense that "I was just following orders" overcome a charge for complicity in human rights violations.
That was all [established at Nuremberg](https://substack.com/redirect/e9c3666a-0803-4898-9e17-c51ce1d8614f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), after our nation played a critical role in liberating Europe from Nazi aggression and winning the Second World War.
Those principles require servicemembers to consider ethics and the context of the orders they are given. That is precisely why Aaron's declaration--that "I will no longer be complicit in genocide"--is so important.
Considering Aaron's limited rights to speak out about his concerns, and legal obligations to follow the orders of [a genocidal leader with no concern for international law](https://substack.com/redirect/acf55451-d91e-4a2e-8c16-843662690a15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), his act of self-sacrifice may have seemed like the only course for him to pursue that would allow his voice to be heard.
For instance, one might suppose that he could have dissented and refused to follow orders in relative silence. That would have exposed him to a military court martial, and the ignominy of likely imprisonment without any public awareness of his position. However principled such a decision might have been, it would have amounted to silence.
He chose an alternative that would invite his neighbors to reconsider their complicity and silence, at the cost of his own life. Given his circumstances, his act of sacrifice might be seen as one among only a few ways to publicly dissent from mass murder funded by taxpayers.

### **Bearing witness also means speaking truth to power**
Americans who enjoy First Amendment rights continue to speak out prolifically to champion the same principles that motivated Aaron.
On the same day that he lit himself on fire, thousands of activists in San Francisco [seized control of a major interstate highway](https://substack.com/redirect/ca89366a-1b17-4ac2-aa9b-3bffd0bf3f26?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Others came together to voice public dissent not only up and down the west coast, but also in cities including [St. Louis](https://substack.com/redirect/c81d60f1-4105-4418-9f70-23a907ce70f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), MO and [St. Paul](https://substack.com/redirect/bc5b41cf-bfff-47cf-a59b-f20646ddc907?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), MN.
Yet still, elected leaders from Washington to Sacramento continue to [ignore](https://substack.com/redirect/3d1d129d-3140-4c7f-ad46-9ae441b332e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) their concerns, as well as the requirements of international law.
The world will do its best to forget Aaron Bushnell. Even if Americans have [no effective control](https://substack.com/redirect/7c4ee3b2-c98a-42d9-9400-87900d6ec087?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over our nation's [belligerent and criminal](https://substack.com/redirect/f9cf4eb5-cb72-4e35-846d-1e5b4fd0442c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) foreign policy, we can at least each remember the moral heroes who have tried to draw our attention to the horrors that continue to unfold in plain sight.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c3ac372c-2b13-4629-abe5-35a63329fefb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Buddhist monk Thich Quang Duc immolated himself in 1963 to draw attention to the brutality of the US-backed South Vietnamese government. Popular outrage with the regime's abuses helped precipitate the country's liberation struggle and Washington's invasion and decade-long campaign to suppress it.

Sacrifices by people of conscience are invitations for the rest of us to finally start paying attention | | | Feb 26| | | ∙| | Preview ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | | Yesterday, 25 year-old Aaron Bushnell lit himself on fire outside the Israeli embassy in Washington, DC. As an active duty U.S. service member, his sacrifice is particularly jarring and should draw the world's attention to the need to finally, as he exhorted with his dying breaths, "!" This was a young man who swore his life to defend the security of the United States, only to see it degraded by the decisions of civilian commanders unapologetically committed to a genocide targeting a civilian population. [Aaron's statements] are not the words of someone suffering from illness, but rather those of a lucid being responding to the illness of an ignorant and belligerent civilization that refuses to heed either the demands of international rights or the sacrifices of the veterans who secured them. Aaron's profound act of sacrifice demands observation. | | ---|---|--- A lucid act of self-sacrifice in defense of human rights Some might argue that Aaron was mentally ill. Others will describe his act of protest as suicide. They all would do well to grapple with the lucidity of his thoughts, and his words as he gave away his life to defend others. Aaron's self-immolation was neither an act of despair, nor one driven by confusion. It was an act of moral desperation undertaken by a person whose thoughtful concerns deserve to be heard. Aaron explained his sense of moral urgency. Before lighting himself on fire, he : "My name is Aaron Bushnell, I am an active-duty member of the United States Air Force and I will no longer be complicit in genocide. I am about to engage in an extreme act of protest, but compared to what people have been experiencing in Palestine at the hands of their colonizers, it's not extreme at all. This is what our ruling class has decided will be normal." These are not the words of someone suffering from illness, but rather those of a lucid being responding to the illness of an ignorant and belligerent civilization that refuses to heed either the demands of international rights or the sacrifices of the veterans who secured them. Help inform your friends! Reality more compelling than any fiction Several ironies about Bushnell's act of sacrifice deserve to be noted. First, many outlets have discussed Aaron's sacrifice while suppressing the video featuring his own words in his own voice. Many have claimed to have censored the video because it is disturbing. It is indeed disturbing--but no more so than the images of Palestinians digging the bodies of their children out of the rubble of what were their apartment buildings. Aaron intended for his sacrifice to be seen. That's why he recorded it. Despite efforts to hide the video of his self-immolation from the public, it . Next is the bizarre absurdity documented by the video, which captures a militarized police officer drawing a weapon on Aaron as he lit himself on fire, before another officer explained that "I don't need guns, I need fire extinguishers!" This moment not only encapsulates the characteristic response of the American "justice" system to any particular problem. What drove Aaron to self-sacrifice was the belligerence of U.S. foreign policy and its disregard for human suffering. That same callousness is also reflected in domestic policing, and the institutional tendency in both contexts towards escalating violence at the slightest--or even . Finally, another irony emerges when considering the limited rights of U.S. service members, particularly given their legal obligation to follow the orders of civilian commanders. When pledging their lives to defend national security, U.S. service members give up rights enjoyed by civilians under the First Amendment. They are still allowed to vote, but the of the 2024 presidential election reduces that choice to . Interestingly, international law requires members of militaries to to follow orders that are illegal, regardless of where they are in their chains of command, and who issues the orders. There is no legal justification for following illegal orders, such as those violating human rights, nor can the defense that "I was just following orders" overcome a charge for complicity in human rights violations. That was all , after our nation played a critical role in liberating Europe from Nazi aggression and winning the Second World War. Those principles require servicemembers to consider ethics and the context of the orders they are given. That is precisely why Aaron's declaration--that "I will no longer be complicit in genocide"--is so important. Considering Aaron's limited rights to speak out about his concerns, and legal obligations to follow the orders of , his act of self-sacrifice may have seemed like the only course for him to pursue that would allow his voice to be heard. For instance, one might suppose that he could have dissented and refused to follow orders in relative silence. That would have exposed him to a military court martial, and the ignominy of likely imprisonment without any public awareness of his position. However principled such a decision might have been, it would have amounted to silence. He chose an alternative that would invite his neighbors to reconsider their complicity and silence, at the cost of his own life. Given his circumstances, his act of sacrifice might be seen as one among only a few ways to publicly dissent from mass murder funded by taxpayers. To support my work and enable more of it, consider becoming a paid subscriber. Bearing witness also means speaking truth to power Americans who enjoy First Amendment rights continue to speak out prolifically to champion the same principles that motivated Aaron. On the same day that he lit himself on fire, thousands of activists in San Francisco . Others came together to voice public dissent not only up and down the west coast, but also in cities including , MO and , MN. Yet still, elected leaders from Washington to Sacramento continue to their concerns, as well as the requirements of international law. The world will do its best to forget Aaron Bushnell. Even if Americans have over our nation's foreign policy, we can at least each remember the moral heroes who have tried to draw our attention to the horrors that continue to unfold in plain sight. | | ---|---|--- Buddhist monk Thich Quang Duc immolated himself in 1963 to draw attention to the brutality of the US-backed South Vietnamese government. Popular outrage with the regime's abuses helped precipitate the country's liberation struggle and Washington's invasion and decade-long campaign to suppress it. Team Roca was hard at work this weekend putting signs across the district. If you have a location where you would like to host a large sign, please go to our website and fill out the Sign Request form below to let us know! 🇺🇸
| [SIGN REQUEST]()

# Online Weekly Reminder
|
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=0a474f720b&e=0a12281e0e)
**This is a reminder for our weekly virtual****Roca for Congress Volunteer Meeting this Tuesday at 6PM!**
We know that many of our volunteers are geographically located across the district and might not be able to attend our in-person volunteer events and meetings. We will be holding weekly online meetings EVERY TUESDAY @ 6PM so we can all get together online via teams and discuss volunteering activities. If you are interested in volunteering and would like to join us for the virtual online meeting, please register to volunteer by filling out the sign-up sheet below.
| [VOLUNTEER SIGN-UP](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=91cc3d54b4&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Postcard Writing
|
---
We are in need of more volunteers to help us handwrite the postcard below to voters across the district. We believe that a personal handwritten note is a nice touch that voters will appreciate.
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
If you are currently writing postcards for us please let us know once you are don with your batch. We need to start collecting these to get started with sorting them and getting ready for mailing. If you are interested in writing postcards, please fill out the volunteer sign-up form below!
| [VOLUNTEER SIGN-UP](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=eea72c96b7&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Door Knocking
|
---
Door knocking/canvassing is a fundamental aspect of political outreach that remains invaluable in engaging with voters on a personal level. The impact of face-to-face interactions cannot be overstated, as they offer a unique opportunity to establish genuine connections, understand constituents' concerns, and convey the candidate's message directly.
This past Saturday, with the dedicated support of a small but passionate team of volunteers, we successfully knocked on over 250 doors within Frederick County. However, our work is far from over, and with your help, we can extend our reach even further.
Next weekend, May 2nd & 3rd, we will continue our door knocking efforts in two key areas within Frederick County. Your participation is crucial in amplifying our efforts and ensuring that our voice is heard with as many voters as possible. If you can join us this weekend, please sign up below by filling out the Volunteer Sign-Up sheet and select door knocking from the option. We will be in touch as soon as you sign up! 🇺🇸
| [VOLUNTEER SIGN-UP](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=1a6b0cd4d5&e=0a12281e0e)
---
# Frederick County Volunteer Event
|
---
**Frederick County Volunteer Event:****THIS WEEK Thursday, February 29th 6-8 pm****at Mission BBQ in Frederick!**
Join us for our next volunteer event this week! It's a chance to meet like-minded individuals, share ideas, and contribute your time and skills to the campaign.
We'll be gathering at Mission BBQ here in Frederick, MD. Our volunteers are amazing and we always have a great time so come join us if you can!
Click the button below to RSVP via facebook so you can get a reminder, or reply back to this email to let us know you are joining us on Thursday! ⬇️
| [FREDERICK VOLUNTEER RSVP](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=75563d9693&e=0a12281e0e)

Joining our the Roca for Congress team isn't just about supporting me as the candidate – it's about being part of a family that's passionate about making real change happen in our country. Whether you're a seasoned volunteer or just dipping your toes into politics, there's a place for you here.
Let's work together to knock on doors, make calls, and spread the word in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District. Every small effort leads us a bit further in ensuring we secure victory in the primary election on May 14th! Feel free to spread the word and sign-up to volunteer below if you haven’t already.

# Three Things to Know This Week:
---
1. **Early Voting is Underway in Ohio! Make a Plan to Vote!**

2. **Matt Dolan Wins Second Consecutive GOP Senate Debate**

| | |

_**Early Voting is Underway in Ohio! Make a Plan to Vote!**_

* Ohioans can vote via absentee ballot and in-person between now and Election Day

* Information on how to [request an absentee ballot](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=7d1aa7194d7048eab4257e9870bfdd5f&_e=X7-TUt46mySYMRg1OGmlC7FzJGPxrr5p9b9vpLFM5NEZT2uMU1ws5r0mcTSqpTJkNp9Xx6t01dyV0iP0IGv0lFxgvuFQ1Xgt4e7r-7NgqMy9JpqXVfc8AlWoaA8rFQZVBm8KkH_ASWCJA2F5gaKtgJK-P_lauHl1OZJ1jJVvVh8h9-sF3MqAz78mtEuFOBnJ9kB2gHA834AU-U14cOcmeeCgh4Df-7RKXjTv5ylo23qoMeyJ_V-TUbqCM0raxwtLrnsekaJueW3ST3qMMZgHIw%3D%3D) and other important election-related dates is available [here](http://links.dolanforsenate.com/u/click?_t=879ec3883fbb432d91bdf6fa5c9b36c6&_m=7d1aa7194d7048eab4257e9870bfdd5f&_e=X7-TUt46mySYMRg1OGmlC5XlRbldCW6dst-4SBBib_RhIR9oEvVv2-elk9nhS6CUyIzsDa8ny-5oxi-sQ5T8QyPv7ExH2r4_P7C0cigruPCcYk7VJ_ACRYullqZin8AELbLpUyNEqw4JkBwmzZ4LdhwrzKXdz1ULs6PHscKu6U4GL3SAxHhdw-K_4o0asE-_OZJwVnVVInQy7gVjFpB3H6mY7qwvxY6qPqYLx7nrzws%3D).

_**Matt Dolan Wins Second Consecutive GOP Senate Debate**_
* Matt Dolan won his second consecutive Republican US Senate debate last week by demonstrating that he is the only candidate with the resources and record of conservative achievement.

* Unlike his GOP opponents, Matt Dolan has not reinvented himself and can highlight Sherrod Brown’s extreme positions that are out of step with Ohioans, such as voting with Joe Biden 98 percent of the time, vowing to pack the Supreme Court and gutting the filibuster.

subject: Weekly Update from Rep. Ryan Chamberlin
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12682684?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My fellow Floridians,

As we begin Week 8 of the Legislative Session, nearly all committees and subcommittees have stopped meeting. This past week in Tallahassee, I heard 26 bills in the Judiciary Committee and voted on 52 bills while in the House Chamber. One of these bills was HB 1, which will protect our kids from the harmful impacts of social media. This legislation was passed in the House and Senate and will be going to the Governor for his signature.

Now, we are preparing for the 2024 budget conference and being in the House Chamber for Session. Over the next two weeks, our main objective is to finalize the budget. This is an important time for our state!
---
| | **HB 1 - Online Protections for Minors**
---
|
---
---
| I am proud to be a legislator in the Free State of Florida! At the end of last week, the Florida Legislature passed [**HB 1**](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=a3e1deec49&e=d1c1b9864f) with incredible bipartisan support. This great bill I co-sponsored will hold social media companies accountable and prohibit children under 16 from accessing social media platforms. Numerous studies show that social media has addictive qualities and seriously harms the mental health of young people. These Tech Giants know about the negative effects of social media, but all they care about is their profits. HB 1 will make an incredible difference in the lives of children across our state. It was an honor to support this great piece of legislation!
---
|
---
| As a co-sponsor, I had the opportunity to participate in a press conference regarding the passing of HB 1. I applaud Speaker Paul Renner and the bill sponsors for their hard work and dedication to safeguarding the mental health and well-being of the next generation of Floridians. I look forward to the good work we will continue to accomplish for our state in the final two weeks of the 2024 Legislative Session!
---
| | **Update on My Legislation**
---
|
---
| My bill, **[HB 1415](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=9dcf3294b3&e=d1c1b9864f)** , has been added to the Special Order Calendar and is scheduled to be heard tomorrow on the House Floor. HB 1415 would extend peer support opportunities to correctional officers and correctional probation officers. Peer support means to aid in physical, moral, or emotional support to a first responder by a first responder peer for the purpose of addressing physical or emotional conditions associated with being a first responder. I am proud of my work on this good bill and look forward to its success on the House Floor!
---
|
---
| | It is an honor to represent District 24 in Tallahassee! As always, if I may be of any assistance, please do not hesitate to contact my office by **[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=20ffa19c79&e=d1c1b9864f "https://www.myfloridahouse.gov/Sections/Representatives/contactmember.aspx?MemberId=4901&SessionId=103&utm_source=Ryan+Chamberlin+for+State+Representative&utm_campaign=ae0a433299-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_12_08_05_14_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-7ddd94a0de-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D")**.

Have a great week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
---

subject: personally reaching out
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
I wanted to cut through the noise and write to you today
Derek, with just eight days until the primary election, I want to cut through the noise and explain where things stand in this race.
Last week two new polls dropped. The first, showed us in third place, behind Republican Steve Garvey by six points. **The second, conducted later when voters had more time to see our ads, showed us one point ahead of Garvey and in second place.** These polls also show that large margins of voters—nearly 20% are still undecided about who to support.
So while this forward movement is a promising sign, Schiff saw the exact same poll. He has been spending millions of dollars to try and *boost* Garvey into the second place spot so that he has an easy-to-defeat general election opponent.
**Both Schiff and his super PAC are spending heavily on Fox News to propel Garvey into second place, despite Schiff’s previous calls for advertisers to boycott the network.**
To be frank, Schiff and the super PACs supporting him are just drowning us out. As of today, he reportedly spent $22.3 million on advertising in the past six weeks, **has twice as much cash on hand as us** , and is outspending us three to one on TV.
On top of that, a crypto industry backed super PAC has spent **$7M on deceptive ads** attacking me.
**I wouldn’t ask for your $5 if this race was hopeless.** Even though we’ve been outspent throughout this race, we’re still in a dead heat for second place. As voters tune in during this final stretch, we must reach the millions who are still undecided.
If I come in third, my time in Congress—fighting corruption, holding polluters accountable, and as the only single mom of school aged kids—comes to an end. If we make it past the primary, polling shows I have a strong chance of winning the general. I just need your help, right now, to stand up to the corporate special interests attempting to buy this seat. **With just eight days left, can you make a $5 donation right now?**
Here’s a link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240226-2](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20240226-2?refcode=em20240226-38298&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38298_3422442_Ae7hPF&akid=38298%2E3422442%2EAe7hPF)**
Thank you in advance, I can’t do this without you.
Katie

Friend, Rep. Jamaal Bowman has been a fierce ally by my side as we hold our government’s leaders accountable for their complicity in the ethnic cleansing of Palestinians. | | | Peter, just wanted to make sure you saw my email below. Women being forced to compete against men in sports is INSANITY. Peter,

I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again – it's **ridiculous** and **asinine** that we’re even having to talk about biological men competing in women’s sports. Yet here we are today thanks to woke-left insanity.

In recent years, transgender “women” have won dozens of women’s sports championships. Young women are being robbed of educational opportunities that sports provide.

_And we’ve all seen the stories about young women who’ve been badly hurt while competing against biological males who have an undeniable physical advantage over them._
---

| **Democrats decry lack of legislative action on gun violence**
The House of Representatives advanced omnibus public safety legislation to the Senate on Feb. 19 but only after Democrats highlighted the need to address gun violence following the mass shooting days earlier at the Kansas City Chiefs Super Bowl victory parade. The bill passed on a bipartisan vote of 120-26, with eight members voting present.

Although the wide-ranging bill enjoyed broad support, Democrats focused on provisions to strengthen Missouri’s lax gun laws that weren’t included – and that Republican House leadership refuses to advance. Since taking control of both legislative chambers in 2003, Republicans have steadily weakened the state’s gun restrictions, including by allowing people to carry concealed weapons without a permit or training and allowing guns in more public spaces.

Dozens of state lawmakers from both parties attended the parade and many were present in the immediate area where the shooting took place. Two men so far have been criminally charged in the incident, which resulted in one dead and more than 20 wounded, including nine children. While several Democrats who were there talked about their experiences, Republicans who attended largely remained silent.

Provisions of House Bill 1659 includes about a dozen provisions, including those increasing penalties for drug trafficking, expanding when armed criminal action charges can be filed, making engaging in celebratory gunfire a specific crime and increasing the minimum age to charge a juvenile as an adult from 12 to 14 for most felonies. Controversial provisions include limiting the authority of local civilian police oversight boards and boosting penalties for harming police dogs, with no exceptions for acts of self-defense in response to unlawful attacks.

| **HELP FOR SMALL BUSINESS AND NON- PROFITS **
The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

SBA’s Economic Injury Disaster Loans offer up to $2 million in assistance for each affected small business or non-profit. These loans can provide vital economic support to small businesses to help overcome the temporary loss of revenue they are experiencing.

Applicants will be able to apply online, receive additional disaster assistance information and [download applications](https://robertsforstl.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6e3f7ee3b541518ea63c7e773&id=47de451e77&e=a088917f89). Steve Roberts, D-St. Louis updates constituents on important legislation passed through the legislature this week. | | Contact Senator Roberts 201 W. Capitol Ave., Rm 329 Jefferson City, MO 65101 (573) 751-4415 Steve.Roberts@senate.mo.gov | | | | | | | | | | | | Democrats decry lack of legislative action on gun violence The House of Representatives advanced omnibus public safety legislation to the Senate on Feb. 19 but only after Democrats highlighted the need to address gun violence following the mass shooting days earlier at the Kansas City Chiefs Super Bowl victory parade. The bill passed on a bipartisan vote of 120-26, with eight members voting present. Although the wide-ranging bill enjoyed broad support, Democrats focused on provisions to strengthen Missouri’s lax gun laws that weren’t included – and that Republican House leadership refuses to advance. Since taking control of both legislative chambers in 2003, Republicans have steadily weakened the state’s gun restrictions, including by allowing people to carry concealed weapons without a permit or training and allowing guns in more public spaces. Dozens of state lawmakers from both parties attended the parade and many were present in the immediate area where the shooting took place. Two men so far have been criminally charged in the incident, which resulted in one dead and more than 20 wounded, including nine children. While several Democrats who were there talked about their experiences, Republicans who attended largely remained silent. Provisions of House Bill 1659 includes about a dozen provisions, including those increasing penalties for drug trafficking, expanding when armed criminal action charges can be filed, making engaging in celebratory gunfire a specific crime and increasing the minimum age to charge a juvenile as an adult from 12 to 14 for most felonies. Controversial provisions include limiting the authority of local civilian police oversight boards and boosting penalties for harming police dogs, with no exceptions for acts of self-defense in response to unlawful attacks. | | | | 2024 SENATE BILLS \- Creates the offense of unlawful possession of a firearm by a minor \- Modifies provisions relating to homelessness \- Establishes the grassroots activism matters
| | |

Look, big change starts small.
That's a lesson that my grandmother, Polly Noonan, first taught me decades ago. Well before most women had any political power, my grandmother organized women into a political force in Albany.
By the time I was in elementary school, I was tagging along with her to all kinds of Democratic campaign headquarters, rallies and events. She remains one of my biggest role models — and I carry her wisdom with me to this day. **She taught me that my voice matters, that women’s voices matter and that grassroots activism matters. And she showed me how campaigns are won by the people who put in the work like the volunteers knocking doors, stuffing envelopes, turning out the vote and donating what they can, when they can.**
For decades, first by my grandmother's side and then as a public servant myself, I've seen how those small grassroots actions all add up to victory on Election Day. That's how Democrats defeated the odds in 2022 to defend and even expand our Senate majority. And that's why I know that we can win again in 2024.
With Democrats defending 23 seats, the odds are certainly stacked against us. And after the 2022 red wave in New York, Republicans here are already targeting my seat for defeat. **But when people like you get off the sidelines and chip in even just $3, eventually we'll build a grassroots movement capable of defeating even the GOP's wealthiest megadonors.**

Friend, When Wes Moore and Aruna Miller ran for office, they ran on the promise to bring change to Maryland — and the newly announced State Plan does just that. Earlier this month, the Moore-Miller administration laid out its vision and strategies to accomplish ten priorities:
1. Ending child poverty
2. Setting students up for success
3. Creating an equitable, robust, and competitive economy
4. Connecting Marylanders to jobs
5. Creating safer communities
6. Making Maryland a desirable and affordable home for all residents
7. Advancing infrastructure to connect Marylanders with each other and share more opportunities
8. Ensuring world-class health systems for Marylanders
9. Making Maryland a leader in clean energy and the greenest state in the country
10. Making Maryland a state that serves

This is the first State Plan in almost a decade. We can set up specific metrics to track our progress with these targets. We’re expecting to announce key performance in early 2025 — and we’re looking forward to sharing just how much progress we’ve been able to accomplish since announcing the State Plan. Along with the 2024 legislative agenda, Aruna and Wes are committed to following through on their vision to ensure this is Maryland’s decade. We have a lot to accomplish, so let’s get to work. In solidarity, Team Moore

Derek, The only other birthday I like more than mine is Tim Kaine’s. That’s why I was so excited to deliver him his digital birthday card and one of my famous tuna sandwiches for his special day. Tim likes to call me “culinary-challenged” but we all know he really means “mayo aficionado.” [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/79791021/457486968/601490735?refcode=mw_em_240226_1_a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZGFjMzA0OS1lYWQ0LWVlMTEtODVmOS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3OTQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=2GIwVknE2iVE_HZkiKfJj_avnyLSA0_Kk6U0To_ZK5Y=) When you work closely with someone for so long like I have with Tim, you really get to know all of their little quirks – like not liking mayo. One of Senator Kaine’s, that used to drive me crazy, is his constant optimism. This maddening hopefulness of his that never seems to fade. But over the 40+ years of our friendship, I’ve learned to admire it. I’ve learned to understand that this optimism is exactly what we need in the Senate. Because it doesn’t matter what roadblocks Tim faces along the way... nothing will deter him from serving the people of Virginia. Nothing will stop him from believing that he can continue changing people's lives. That kind of relentless optimism and dedication is what we need from our leaders in a Washington full of partisan division and political games. **__[So, Derek, while I ask you to split a $5 donation I flipped my district in southern New Jersey from red to blue by unseating the Republican incumbent in 2018 – then held it in 2020 and 2022 against two different self-funding millionaires. Now, I'm in my biggest battle yet – I'm running for Senate to restore trust to New Jersey's Senate seat against a political system that doesn't favor candidates like me. If elected, I would be the first AAPI senator from the entire East Coast. = I still believe in the America that my parents came here for. Fifty years ago, they came here because America meant something to them about opportunity and security and I still believe in that — I want that for my kids, so I'm going to continue to fight for the vision that my parents had. This race is about trust. It's about public service. That gets at risk when we have a senator who is indicted on corruption, and now we're seeing the broken politics that protected the senator for so many years now trying to put its thumb on the scale of our elections — including this race.
