| | 2\. Thank you CMR!
---
| | When I ran for Congress, I received a lot of good advice, and I remember clearly what Spokane Mayor Lisa Brown told me. She stated that when she ran for Congress in 2018, she underestimated the importance of rural voters, which she believes may have cost her the race. Despite having an enormous war chest, she literally could not spend it all in the short span of the election. The Union Bulletin recently published an [article](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/beOseiCbQ/c?w=FTW21zWHAf0B0MMQpT6B0qwoGey6M_K-z2GdjY8cy1o.) stating that this was the best time for Democrats to flip Washington’s Congressional District 5 (CD5), and there is a good reason for it because we know what needs to be done. Rural Americans United is predicated on learning from the many mistakes made by individuals like myself, others, and truly listening to our constituents, even when what we hear goes against what we personally believe. It is still more important to listen and act on the interests of our constituents. From a numbers game, we know we can win in CD5 because that is what the voters are telling us. Recently, Spokane elected a Democratic Mayor, and the incumbent is exiting long before her career needs to end. Additionally, as reported by [Politico](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/beOseiCbQ/c?w=VC20wym_qCPVuYhSUXR2pF3nCZVymr2EIO5l1X1LFsI.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucG9saXRpY28uY29tLzIwMjAtZWxlY3Rpb24vcmVzdWx0cy93YXNoaW5ndG9uLyIsInIiOiI5NzU0NDNmOC1kYjkyLTRkMDUtOTZlYS0xNWVkMjE1NjdkZjQiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ), Whitman County voted for Biden in 2020 by 10%, in Walla Walla County Biden lost by only 6%, and in Spokane County, it was only 4%. These three counties make up approximately 80% of all voters, and a Democrat losing by single digits anywhere East of the Cascades is considered a Swing District if not an actual win. Party politics is often a nuanced dance by politicians, but by listening to constituents, we already know some platform positions. The first is to stay away from education or find a way to support parents' roles without bringing up culture wars. The Republican Party has made a rally cry out of homeschool, voucher programs, dismantling the Department of Education, breaking the teachers' union, anti-WOKE, and anti-LGBT+. Abortion is another kill stroke for rural Democrats. A woman’s right to autonomy over her body is absolute, but this most delicate issue must be framed in context of everyone’s right to bodily autonomy; it is freedom of self-determination. Immigration is a focal topic of the 2024 elections, and Democratic candidates will need to be well-positioned to address their constituents. In CD5, immigration as an issue, at least on the surface, appears more straightforward than in neighboring CD4. Data shown by [DataUsa.io](https://www.ruralamericansunited.org/so/beOseiCbQ/c?w=5b98VPeaPzm_CZBBxe4zz-MNgWpY_7Sz9yfIkq0ApwQ.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9kYXRhdXNhLmlvLyIsInIiOiI5NzU0NDNmOC1kYjkyLTRkMDUtOTZlYS0xNWVkMjE1NjdkZjQiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiIyNzdlN2Y0YS0wMGUzLTQ4ZmMtYmI5Ny02NTRiM2ZhMzc0YTgifQ) indicates that CD5 is a majority White district (82%), with persons identifying as non-White and non-Hispanic making up the majority of remaining residents. This coupled with a high citizenship rate of over 97%, suggests that an immigration platform can be less nuanced, and therefore a Democratic candidate can take a stronger position and hold that ground. In CD4, where the Latinx population is roughly 50% and citizenship is below 90%, more dimensions must be included in any meaningful discussion of immigration; dimensions that affect people’s lives in real and meaningful ways. It is hard to imagine anywhere else in the country where so many factors come into play with regard to immigration than in CD4. Discussing money in politics, it's important to note that simply throwing money at a campaign doesn't guarantee success. As Lisa Brown shared with me, she had more money than she could spend, yet it didn't secure victory. Every politician, consultant, and voting record will show you that facts don’t win elections; emotions do. Having strangers or candidates making aggressive promises at the last minute will win few favors. To truly win, we must connect with the hearts and minds of people on the issues that matter most to them and be there every day. Rural Americans United understands this, which is why we've launched our pro-democratic messaging campaign. We are educating, reminding, and persuading people that democratic values mirror theirs most closely and will give us the future we all deserve. name: American Briefing
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history,

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zoppa8g45ju9noadovd0up4hd8fimsr2qibjr6ko_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s1g68ob0c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled “The Second World Wars.”
Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zdm60j8hr5kf7h8uolfca8t6gluk0l438i8brc3g_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s1g68ob0c3h2bs) If you’d like to secure a DVD set before they’re all gone, you can get one shipped directly to your home for any gift of $100 or more to Hillsdale College.
Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of “**The Second World Wars** ” on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zjug289q334v21cedc6q2g348g9an1j83ninahk0_rp22sh2s8i6eo34s1g68ob0c3h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!

Kyle Murnen, ’09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

I’m proud to have earned the endorsement of my friend, Williamson County Commissioner Terry Cook.

“In these turbulent times, I am so proud to be able to endorse the candidacy of Round Rock native Stuart Whitlow for Congressional District 31, a candidate rising high above the fray.
Seldom do we benefit from someone with a lifetime of service to residents of Central Texas which illuminates his true character, focus and high energy level which is so needed for our Congressional District and for the Congress.

This is a man of action, not just words, and fully one of demonstrated dedication to serving others. He will make a positive addition to congress and should rise swiftly to positions of leadership (directly and indirectly) filing thoughtful bills and mentoring others.
We will take pride in calling him our congressman.”
— Terry Cook
_Williamson County Commissioner_

From his long and wholistic focus on supporting 2- and 4-yr educational opportunities, as well as technical skills development for low-income residents, including daycare assistance if needed, through his development of the non-profit Capital Idea programs to his dedication in providing legal assistance to low-income clients through the Texas Legal Service Center and to the training of young lawyers to be effectively responsive in that work. This is a man of action, not just words, and fully one of demonstrated dedication to serving others. He will make a positive addition to congress and should rise swiftly to positions of leadership (directly and indirectly) filing thoughtful bills and mentoring others. We will take pride in calling him our congressman.” — Terry Cook Williamson County Commissioner I'm running for Congress to stand for ALL Texans. There's so much to get done for the families of this country, and it’s time to get Congress back on track. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | I’ve spent a lifetime delivering real results for everyday folks here in District 31. And with your support, I’m ready to deliver for ALL Texans in Congress. Thanks for being with me, Stuart WhitlowDemocrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31 | Stuart Whitlow is a lifelong Democrat and a fifth-generation resident of TX-31 running to unseat Trump’s ally in Congress, MAGA Republican John Carter. As a lawyer, Stuart has more than 35 years experience representing folks like us and taking on those in power. Now, he’s running for Congress to stand up for ALL Texans against the extremism of the MAGA movement. Stuart’s opponent has put Trump’s interests ahead of America’s interests, and it’s wrecked havoc on Capitol Hill and here at home. Stuart knows that TX-31 needs a Congress that works for all us, not just for Donald Trump. “We take care of each other here in Texas, and we deserve leaders in Congress who can be trusted to do the same. That's why I'm ready to fight for our values in Congress and stand up for ALL Texans. I'm asking for your support in the Democratic Primary on March 5th — so together, we can make sure our Texas values live on.” — Stuart Whitlow Democrat for U.S. Congress, TX-31 | | | | | | Whitlow for Congress 910 Quest Pkwy Apt 6113 Cedar Park, TX 78613-2658 * USA

Peter, it’s been one year since we launched our campaign for reelection. So I wanted to share a story with you:

I grew up on my family’s farm, and I still work the land today. That explains a lot about me.

When I was a kid, I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident while working in our family’s butcher shop. I don’t even remember putting my hand there—but I damn sure remember pulling it out.

Here’s why I’m telling you this: Just like my $12 flattop haircut and my dirt-stained t-shirts, **my background is a big part of the reason I remain grounded and focused on defending Montana.**

With all the chaos in Washington (especially now), you need somebody who will roll up their sleeves and get to work.

**I’m pretty different from most people who end up in the U.S. Senate. I’m a proud dirt farmer trying to do what’s right for the people in my state and across the country. But I’m in the toughest campaign of my life, and I need your help more than ever.**

Friend, I have breaking news to share with you... We at America First Legal have just filed an **absolutely momentous** lawsuit in Maricopa County, Arizona against their elections officials for repeatedly and egregiously violating the State of Arizona's election administration laws. The election interference and systematic election law violations we allege in Arizona are appalling, bone-chilling, and have the most serious consequences for every American. is Adam Schiff Jacky: And this is Jacky Rosen. Adam: I'm running for the
U.S. Senate in California Jacky: I'm running for reelection to defend our
Senate majority here in Nevada. Adam: Along with sharing a strong
commitment to our Democratic values, we have another thing in common:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em_rosen.p9LfBk&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240226_PM1_V1_S1&t=1005&akid=5714%2E5257348%2ExrK2TS ]Text exchange between Adam Schiff and Jacky Rosen: Jacky: Our faith
Adam: I’ve long been guided by the Jewish principle of “Tikkun Olam” —
repairing the world. Jacky:As the first synagogue president elected to the
United States Senate, I’ve taught it and lived it. Adam: We’re running so
that we can leave our country and the world better off. Jacky: I’m so
proud to be fighting for positive change for communities across Nevada,
just like Adam is in California.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em_rosen.p9LfBk&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240226_PM1_V1_S1&t=1006&akid=5714%2E5257348%2ExrK2TS ]Text exchange between Adam Schiff and Jacky Rosen: Adam: But the truth
is, we need your help. Jacky: A shady GOP billionaire is propping up Mitch
McConnell’s handpicked candidate to defeat me, and the polling is neck and
neck. Experts say Nevada could decide Senate control. Adam: And our March
5 election in California is coming down to the wire — with Republican
Steve Garvey making a late surge in this race.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em_rosen.p9LfBk&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240226_PM1_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=5714%2E5257348%2ExrK2TS ]Text exchange between Adam Schiff and Jacky Rosen: Jacky: We’re relying
on your immediate grassroots support so we can keep up the fight for our
shared values. Adam: If these shared priorities resonate with you, can you
rush $10 or any amount to split between our campaigns? Jacky: It’s such a
blessing to have committed grassroots activists like yourself on our team.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em_rosen.p9LfBk&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240226_PM1_V1_S1&t=1008&akid=5714%2E5257348%2ExrK2TS ]Text exchange between Adam Schiff and Jacky Rosen: Adam: We couldn’t do
it without you. Jacky: So before we let you go, I have to ask: Can you
chip in $10 or any amount to split between Adam Schiff and our campaign to
defend the Senate in Nevada? Adam: Over the past several years, there has
been a lot that’s been broken, and a lot to fix.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=feb2024_abs_em_rosen.p9LfBk&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240226_PM1_V1_S1&t=1009&akid=5714%2E5257348%2ExrK2TS ]Text exchange between Adam Schiff and Jacky Rosen: Jacky: But Adam and
I are confident that with this grassroots team by our side, there is
nothing we can’t accomplish. Adam: Thanks so much for your support.

— Jacky Rosen and Adam Schiff

#### In this episode, the boys are joined by special guest, Brittany Martinez for a candid conversation about her experience working for the Republican Party. From their roots in diverse communities to their journeys to Capitol Hill, Chuck, Mike, and Brittany share their unique perspectives on navigating the world of politics as Latinos, emphasizing their experiences feeling like an outsider in a political landscape not built for Latinos.

body:
Latest Revelations Make Clear that MAGA Republicans Are Fueling the Weiss Campaign | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7563870c3639/joanna-weiss-accepts-tens-of-thousands-of-dollars-from-top-maga-donors-15671080?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** February 26, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Joanna Weiss Accepts Tens of Thousands of Dollars From MAGA Donors**
_Joanna Weiss's campaign finance reports read like a who's who of GOP donors, with their dollars speaking louder than her Democratic facade_
**IRVINE, CA** — [Joanna Weiss for Congress campaign has received tens of thousands in support from prominent Republican donors](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=7e453b8a39&e=7017cc100e), according to the Federal Election Commission’s most recent release of campaign finance filings. This revelation follows previous reports showing that the super PAC supporting Joanna Weiss — currently over $3.6 million and counting – [has also largely been funded by MAGA Republicans](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=ec2da68d0b&e=7017cc100e), and that [Weiss has been self-funding her campaign with hundreds of thousands of dollars earned from defending the Catholic Church in its child molestation and sex abuse cases](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=3ccab561e1&e=7017cc100e).

**“The revelation of Joanna Weiss's campaign finances paints a disturbing picture: tens of thousands of dollars in funding from MAGA Republicans, self-funding from defending the Catholic Church in sexual abuse cases, and a lack of prior political experience or residency in CA-47,”** said Amelia Matier, campaign spokesperson.**“It raises the question: is Weiss's Democratic candidacy a Trojan horse for Republican interests, using her campaign to sow division and undermine the party from within? With donations from individuals like Robert Kargman, who bankrolls the likes of Trump and Herschel Walker, and Steven Klinghoffer, a financier of Cruz and Rubio, it's clear her allegiances lie far from the Democratic values she claims to represent. Voters in CA-47 deserve better than a candidate bankrolled by those seeking to undermine their interests.”**

Among the long list of contributions from major Republican donors are the following:
* $5,500 from Robert Kargman, who has contributed to MAGA Republicans including Donald Trump, Herschel Walker, Michelle Steel, Kelly Loeffler, Ron Johnson, and Vivek Ramaswamy.
* $3,300 from Steven Klinghoffer, who has contributed to Steve Scalise, Ted Cruz, Lindsay Graham, and Marco Rubio.
* $3,300 from Robert Efroymson, who has contributed to Mike Johnson, Ted Cruz, David Perdue, and Kevin McCarthy
* $3,300 from Mona Sterling, who has contributed to Mike Johnson, Doctor Oz for Senate, JD Vance, and Lee Zeldin.
* $3,300 from Marty Glick, who has contributed to Herschel Walker, Tim Scott, Ken Calvert, and David Perdue
* $3,300 from Louis Kaplow, who has contributed to Mike Johnson, Ken Calvert, and Steve Scalise.
* $3,300 from Larry Mizel, who has contributed to Donald Trump, Mike Pence, Mike Johnson, Ted Cruz, JD Vance, Doctor Oz for Senate, Ted Cruz, and Kevin McCarthy.
* $1,000 from Howard Krane, who testified in support of far-right Judge Robert Bork’s 1987 nomination to the U.S. Supreme Court.

Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. body:
Joe is running to deliver on the promise of a freer, fairer, and more prosperous America. If you’d like to unsubscribe, click here. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/94ejtxKhx0qNdkch_i3mjw2?unsubscribedata=nwNNjUoGPVEHO20lFn1J87VrIcB%2BZqFHpXduZ1gQt%2FjlG1MUHv8g8SBwjqKUrjqwpyRwfLo%2BER04qY9yVx%2B%2BeIaHVFNVA84%2BEfVmM3CEJ%2FtisKZq3Pl1ZeDl2vaCqu3DA%2BGgyOUpT9xwOMuDCOmmAomhoL%2Bz4QtgJvRFM%2FF8%2FxzOALl7qKqVj2wPKUmPoQzWUpK5eUArDR4%2F88%2BNuHQI4cXutU8UV2xHOE1PHtveClutJQeTIViK%2FdMXkh3djdDFukpLUJxHivheBRVEjzIrEoJyllUp0TMmYLoeM7dGFxb2fK9VaGozsJlsSmzjy%2FvyO0RcALQoF18KPCByVzF7ZMQzZ2%2B3Vqur0isI3tT8Pycr8nsC5Gm3iXek6JztEhZnd8AZ4R%2BActLN1HxRg%2BlmtccG41eAbu0yy4Jgu0pO0QiU9%2Br7TFs8L8Hqz4qx4D1l]

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jsfc-em-footer [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jsfc-em-footer]
Hey Peter,

I am so excited to share my latest endorsement: Italian American Democrats!

https://secure.ngpvan.com/6YHrkDKzJkSPFi8EtB_-ZQ2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6YHrkDKzJkSPFi8EtB_-ZQ2]

For over 30 years, Italian American Democrats have given a voice to the Italian American community by raising funds, advocating for candidates, and mobilizing voters. They have worked with some of the biggest names in politics like Nancy Pelosi and First Lady, Dr. Jill Biden. They have done so much to advance the values of the Italian American community, and I’m humbled they trust me to represent them.

This endorsement is an honor, but the most important one in this race is yours, Peter. You are the reason I am running for Congress, and I would love to have your endorsement. Click here now to endorse my campaign for Congress! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6YHrkDKzJkSPFi8EtB_-ZQ2]

ENDORSE MY CAMPAIGN [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6YHrkDKzJkSPFi8EtB_-ZQ2]

This campaign is about more than just flipping this district blue. It's about electing a leader who is willing to fight for the issues you care about. Jeff Van Drew took your support for granted by promising South Jersey that he would uphold the values that he ran on, only to abandon his word for the promise of MAGA money and power.

I will never take your support for granted, and I will always do what is best for you and South Jersey when I’m in Congress. To get there, though, I need your support. Will you make your endorsement today so I can stand up against JVD and his far-right agenda? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/6YHrkDKzJkSPFi8EtB_-ZQ2]

Thank you,

Joe Salerno
https://www.facebook.com/JoeSalernoforCongress/?show_switched_toast=0&show_invite_to_follow=0&show_switched_tooltip=0&show_podcast_settings=0&show_community_review_changes=0&show_community_rollback=0&show_follower_visibility_disclosure=0</ [https://www.facebook.com/JoeSalernoforCongress/?show_switched_toast=0&show_invite_to_follow=0&show_switched_tooltip=0&show_podcast_settings=0&show_community_review_changes=0&show_community_rollback=0&show_follower_visibility_disclosure=0</] https://twitter.com/joesalernoNJ [https://twitter.com/joesalernoNJ] https://www.instagram.com/joesalernoforcongress/ [https://www.instagram.com/joesalernoforcongress/]
We all want leaders to deliver for our families. But today, too many of our leaders spend their time fighting just for the sake of fighting.
As your Congressman, I will use the skills I learned during a lifetime in business to deliver for the people of South Jersey.

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: Historic early vote success
disclaimer_text:
Paid for by
Jocelyn Benson for Secretary of State
body:
Friends,

Michigan's early voting period came to an end as of this past Sunday. It was truly a historic success, and it wouldn't have been possible without the determination and dedication of over 1500 local clerks and our 83 county clerks. I'm so thankful for the team we have been able to put together, and every single person involved in the early voting period deserves our gratitude.

I wanted to share some updates with you about the history we made together. My pledge has always been to make sure Michigan's elections are safe, transparent, and accessible. I'm proud to announce that in this historic early voting period, over 1 million voters have made their voices heard already -- a 13% higher pre-Election Day turnout than in 2020. That's a reflection of Michigan's expanded voting options.

Remember, in 2020, Michiganders could only cast their ballots via mail, drop box, or returning them to their clerk's office. This year, we rolled out in person early voting, and over the initial nine day early voting period, more than 78,000 Michigan citizens turned out and voted. Just this past weekend, almost 20,000 votes were cast -- 11,000 yesterday alone.

It's clear that the more people know about their voting options, the more likely they are to take advantage of them. Those early votes are in addition to the over 927,000 completed and submitted absentee ballots returned -- a significant increase over the 2020 primary as well.

All we know right now is how many ballots have been cast -- none will be tabulated, calculated, or revealed in any way before 8:00PM on Election Day. Overall, though, the numbers we can see are great news for Michigan -- citizens are more engaged than ever and willing to go make their voices heard.

I would be remiss if I didn't thank the entire team at the Bureau of Elections and all of our clerks who have worked tirelessly under tight timelines to ensure that Michigan voters can exercise their constitutional right to vote early. It wasn't easy, but their dedication means that voting is that much more accessible for all voters of Michigan.

This early voting period is historic -- but it is also a blueprint for our path forward as a state. The policies Michigan voters stood up and enacted are directly responsible for the growth we saw in this early voting period. I'm looking forward to working together to drive more pro voter policies in the years to come.

I'll follow up on Wednesday with more thoughts on Election Day.

Thank you for your continued support and for all that you do for our democracy.

-Jocelyn

Friend,

**My name is Dalia Al-Aqidi, and I’m running for the House of Representatives in Minnesota’s 5th Congressional District.**
Ilhan Omar has represented our district in Washington for the last five years. In this time, she has done immense damage to Minnesota and our country. **She has chosen hateful rhetoric, partisan politics, and division over fighting for the true interests of her constituents.**

Our district has paid the price.

If you elect me to Congress, I will pull our community together, not rip it apart.

I will support our law enforcement, making Minneapolis a safer place to live, work, and visit.

I will also work to lower inflation and promote energy independence to make America retake its place as the world's dominant superpower.

[](https://nancyforalaska.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b2d5cc6ac5f5c7539b4b1d46&id=262fa5ea31&e=a20d8ad2ed)
**FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE** Contact: [press@nancyforalaska.com](mailto:press@nancyforalaska.com)
**Statement from Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom on Rep. Peltola’s Address to the State Legislature**
**Anchorage, AK** \- Today, Rep. Peltola addressed the Alaska State Legislature and Lt. Governor and candidate for the at-large congressional seat Nancy Dahlstrom released the following statement:
_“What I heard from Congresswoman Peltola today was not enough. Her actions speak so much louder than her words, and they are not in Alaska's best interest. She claims she wants to support Alaska’s energy, but she has been silent when Biden cancels critical energy projects in our state. She claims she wants to be a bipartisan voice, but she votes consistently with radical Democrats.____Congresswoman Peltola talked significantly about the giants of Alaska’s past and her attempt to live up to them. We need someone who doesn’t shrink into those shadows, but rather steps into those shoes with confidence and actually carries on their legacy. I have never backed down from a fight and I will not succumb to political pressures - my words come with action and a record. We need new leadership fighting for us in D.C., and I am ready to take-on that role.”_
Dahlstrom is running against Mary Peltola who has endorsed Joe Biden and works hand-in-hand with his administration. Republican Nancy Dahlstrom currently serves as the Lt. Governor for the state of Alaska. As Lieutenant Governor, Nancy has prioritized public safety, energy security, and emergency preparedness.
# # #

Peter,

_**Did you see this?**_

Voters on Long Island are rejecting the GOP’s rigid _‘my way or the highway’_ political agenda and know Democrats will be champions for them in Congress. We can’t win this without your support.

Friend, in Rick Scott's ideal America ...
❌ _Abortions would be banned nationwide._
🏥 _Social Security and Medicare would be sunset._
